news.title: A notification when your publish request goes through
news.body: If you asked an approver to publish your app, you get an in-app notification the moment it goes live. Read more: Publish approval requests

news.title: Your GitHub identity on commits made from Base44
news.body: A commit made through the GitHub integration carries your GitHub identity as a co-author, so the repository history shows who asked for the change. Read more: GitHub connector

news.title: Make a workspace member an agency partner
news.body: A workspace admin can now grant agency partner status to a member from Members and groups in workspace settings. The status retires on its own when that member leaves the workspace. Available on the Pro plan and above.

news.title: Manage your Wix store products in the app editor
news.body: If your app has a connected Wix store, you can now manage its products from a Store view inside the app editor instead of opening the Wix dashboard in a new tab.

news.title: See which element your Edit mode request applies to
news.body: The element you pick in Edit mode now appears as a chip in the AI chat input, so you can check what your request applies to before you send it. Remove the chip to drop the selection, and the chip stays on the message after you send it. Read more: Design

news.title: Search for people when adding them to a group
news.body: Adding members to a group now opens a search overlay, so you can find people by name instead of scrolling the whole list. The overlay stays open while you add several people, the roster keeps a steady height, and the Groups tab in your app finds the groups a member belongs to by name. Read more: Managing enterprise members

news.title: Email people who are not registered users of your app
news.body: Your app can now send email to addresses that do not belong to a registered app user. This works on a paid plan when your app has a custom domain connected and verified, and every send goes through content screening, recipient hygiene checks, and anti-abuse limits. Read more: Sending emails from your app

news.title: Meet the Base44 community in Basecamp
news.body: Basecamp is the home of the Base44 community. Find a group of builders near you, see what is coming up, and RSVP to workshops, office hours, hackathons, and meetups run by the Base44 team and by builders around the world. Find a community: Search the directory and filter groups by region, platform, interest, and language. Communities moderated by Base44 carry a verified badge, and you can submit your own group to the directory. Join events: RSVP to virtual, in-person, and hybrid events, add them to your calendar, and browse past sessions. To open Basecamp, click Community in your workspace. You can also browse without signing in at base44.com/basecamp. Read more: Finding communities and events in Basecamp

news.title: Advertise an app that asks people to log in
news.body: The Google Ads campaign wizard now accepts apps set to Public with login, so you can move past the budget step without changing your app's visibility. Read more: Creating and launching a campaign

news.title: Unlink a Wix store from your app
news.body: The Wix Commerce card now carries an unlink action that removes the Wix build instructions from your app while the store itself stays live in Wix. If you connect the store again later, your catalog is still there.

news.title: In-app agent replies are charged by what they use
news.body: Each message your in-app agent answers is now charged on what that answer actually uses, with a small minimum per model, so a short answer costs less than a long one. Read more: How credits are used

news.title: Finished tool groups fold away in AI chat
news.body: A group of tools in AI chat closes itself once its work is done, so the conversation stays easy to scan. A group that is still running stays open.

news.title: Build one message on two models and keep the version you prefer
news.body: Every AI model has its own strengths, so instead of guessing which one fits your request, you can now run the same message on two models at once and choose the result you like. Pick the 2 models from the model picker, click Compare, then send your message. Preview before you commit: The chat shows each version's status as it builds, then asks which you prefer. Your main app stays untouched until you choose, and you can reject both. Find them in your branches: Each compared version is a branch of your app, so both are in your branches list while you decide. Comparing models requires a Builder plan or higher, and it builds your message twice, so it uses 2× credits. Read more: Comparing models

news.title: Sign in with a Microsoft name that is not your email
news.body: If your Microsoft sign-in name is different from your email address, you can now sign in with either one. Base44 matches you against the identifiers Microsoft provides, so nothing extra is needed from you or your admin. Read more: Setting up Microsoft Entra SSO

news.title: Give access to a private app at sign-in
news.body: Available for admins and owners on the Enterprise plan. A private app can grant access on a successful SSO sign-in, so anyone who authenticates through your identity provider gets in without waiting for an invite. Off by default: Set a workspace-level default, then override it on any app with on, off, or inherit, so some apps can stay invite only. What it needs: The app has to be set to Private, and your workspace has to have SSO configured. Read more: Automatically giving access to private apps

news.title: One credit rule for every email your app sends
news.body: Every email your app sends is now charged and logged the same way, whichever part of your app sends it. Emails from workflows use integration credits: A workflow email uses an integration credit, the same as an email sent from your app's code, and appears in App Logs and your credit reports. Once your workspace reaches its integration credit limit, a workflow email stops with an out-of-credits error. An email that never leaves costs nothing: A send that does not go through gets its own App Logs row at no credit, and configuration and limit problems name what to change, so you can fix the cause without guessing. Read more: Exploring app logs and How credits are used

news.title: A credit toward your first Google Ads campaign
news.body: If your account qualifies, the campaign wizard now shows a first-campaign credit offer in your own currency, so you can see what you get back before you set a budget. Read more: Tracking your ad credits

news.title: 88 more schools on the student discount
news.body: Students and educators at 88 newly added institutions can claim the student discount with their school email address. Read more: Student discount

news.title: Comment on your app while you build
news.body: Pin a comment to any element on your app preview and work through feedback in a thread with the people you build with. Everyone who can edit the app sees the same comments, and new activity appears for all of you as it happens. Threads stay put: A comment stays anchored to its element as your app changes, so a thread still points at the right spot after your next build. Hand a thread to Base44: Send a comment to the AI chat and Base44 works through the feedback for you. Only you see them: Comments live inside the app editor. People using your published app never see them. Read more: Commenting on your app

news.title: Your Superagent can take notes in your meetings
news.body: Your Superagent can join a meeting on your connected calendar as a notetaker. It records the meeting, writes up the notes and action items, saves them to its notes library, and emails them to you once the meeting ends. It works with any meeting that has a video link, such as Google Meet or Zoom. Read more: Recording your meetings

news.title: See a branch's code in the editor
news.body: The Code tab now shows the file tree of the branch you are on, the same one that branch's preview renders. Read more: Working with branches

news.title: Deploy more than 50 backend functions
news.body: Deploying a backend function on its own no longer counts against a 50 function ceiling, whether you deploy from the CLI, the app editor, or an in-app agent. Replacing an app's whole set of functions in a single call still tops out at 50.

news.title: Daily app invite limits follow your plan
news.body: How many people you can invite to your app in a day now depends on your plan, from 250 a day on Starter up to 2,500 on Enterprise. Free and Lite stay at 100. Invites sent from inside a published app are unchanged. Read more: Inviting users to your app

news.title: Share a filtered App Logs view as a link
news.body: Your App Logs filters now live in the page address, so you can send someone the exact view you are looking at, or come back to it later. Clear filters takes them back out. Read more: Filtering logs

news.title: Fable 5.1 in the AI chat
news.body: Fable 5.1 takes the place of Fable 5 in the AI chat. It suits complex, multi-step builds and detailed debugging, when you want thorough results, and it uses more credits for each request. If you had Fable 5 selected, you see Fable 5.1 in its place. Read more: Choosing your model

news.title: Edit your branch's code in the Code tab
news.body: The Code tab now saves to the branch you are on, so you can change your app's code in a branch and leave main untouched. Your changes reach main when you merge. A few files change your whole app rather than one branch. Base44 stops the save on those and points you to main, so you do not need to work out which is which. Read more: Code on a branch

news.title: Save part of a conversation as a note
news.body: Highlight any text in a Superagent conversation and choose Add note to keep it. Later selections from the same conversation are added to that same note, and the confirmation gives you a View note link to open it. Read more: Taking notes

news.title: Turn a note into a kanban board
news.body: A note can now hold a live kanban board, so you can track work alongside everything else you and your Superagent write down. Build it in the note: Add cards and columns, edit them in place, drag a card from one column to another, and use the per-card and per-column menus to make changes. Shared links show the board: When you share a note by link, anyone who opens it sees the board laid out and ready to read. Read more: Taking notes

news.title: Every branch of an imported app gets its own preview
news.body: A branch of an imported app now runs in its own environment with its own preview address, so you can open a branch and see just that branch's version of the app. Branches run independently: Each branch keeps its own queue of messages, so work on one branch does not wait on another. New branches start warm: A new branch copies an existing branch's built code, installed packages, and data, so it is ready to use sooner. Read more: Working with branches

news.title: Example prompts on connector cards
news.body: In the Connectors panel in the app editor, a connector your workspace already has carries a Use button that lists example prompts. Pick one and it drops straight into AI chat. A connector that is already wired into the open app shows a green check. Read more: Connectors

news.title: Templates are moving to free listings
news.body: New template listings are free from here on. A paid template you already published stays paid and fully editable until 30 September 2026, and the listing form now carries a notice about that date. You can switch a paid template to free at any time, and that switch is permanent. Read more: App templates

news.title: Service principals on every enterprise workspace
news.body: Available on the Enterprise plan. An enterprise workspace can create service principals, issue their credentials, and remove them, so an automated system gets its own identity instead of borrowing a person's.

news.title: Security Center for Enterprise Workspaces
news.body: Teams keep building, you keep oversight. Scan and monitor every app in your workspace from one panel and see vulnerabilities ranked by severity, with a drill-down into any single app. Security and IT leads see where to focus first instead of checking one app at a time. Open Security Center from the admin sidebar, available on Enterprise workspaces.

news.title: Branches Are Live in Base44
news.body: Build your V2 while V1 stays live. Branches are a parallel copy of your build: redesign it, test it, or run a campaign version while the published site stays untouched until you merge and publish. Your live version keeps running the whole time, data and all.

news.title: Superagent as a Chrome Extension
news.body: Base44's Superagent is now a Chrome extension that lives inside your browser. It sees what you see and acts in real time: fill forms, pull data, book tickets, and update CRMs, all on the page in front of you.

news.title: Components Library
news.body: Spark up your project with the Base44 Components Library. Build beautiful, professional apps and websites faster: use a component's design exactly as-is or match it to your build's style and content. Now available in the Add (+) button in your app's prompt box.

news.title: Claude Opus 5 on Base44
news.body: Claude Opus 5 is now available on Base44.

news.title: Wiz Integrated with Base44
news.body: Wiz is now integrated with Base44. Your Wiz security policy now covers everything you build on Base44 too, extending your cloud security posture to Base44-built apps automatically.

news.title: Can't Is Dead Radio in the Editor
news.body: Your build session just got a soundtrack. Can't Is Dead Radio is now live inside the Base44 editor: a station for prompting, tweaking, shipping, and politely ignoring anyone who says it can't be done. Hit play. Build something loud.

news.title: Base 1 — Base44s Own Model
news.body: Base44 launched Base 1, its own AI model trained on tens of millions of real builder interactions on the platform, so it understands the shape of a real app from the first prompt. Base44 is now the first app-creation platform with its own model, live in production — Base 1 joins the lineup and the platform automatically picks the best model for whatever you are building.

news.title: Claude Fable 5 on Base44
news.body: Claude Fable 5 is live again on Base44 — back from timeout and ready to build.

news.title: Session Recording
news.body: Base44 now has session recording — watch real people move through your app, spot where they get stuck, then fix what's actually breaking. Cookie consent banner included.

news.title: Partnership with The AI Collective
news.body: Base44 is partnering with The AI Collective to bring hands-on workshops to communities across North America — Boston, Miami, San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, Portland, and Toronto — starting in Boston on July 11th.

news.title: Figma Frames & Custom Fonts
news.body: You can now add Figma frames and mention them in a follow-up prompt to create new pages. Plus, import your own fonts directly into the visual editor's toolbar.

news.title: Ship Your Claude Design with Base44
news.body: Made something cool on Claude Design? You can now ship it easily with Base44 — take your design from Claude Design to a real, working app.

news.title: Superagent Connects to Slack
news.body: Superagent (by Base44) now supports one-click Slack integration — your agent lives in your Slack workspace and can be tagged by name in any channel.

news.title: Voice
news.body: Your Base44 superagent has a voice now — talk to it hands-free, and customize the voice to your preference.

news.title: Opus 4.8 on Base44
news.body: Opus 4.8 is now available on Base44 — 15% faster and significantly better at handling complex tasks.

news.title: Builder Profiles + Reputation Levels
news.body: Earn reputation levels as you build and ship in Base44. Levels unlock real perks — Specialists can apply for the Partner Program. Badges for milestones like your first app, sale, or superagent set-up.

news.title: Base44 Launchpad
news.body: Show what you've built to a real audience of users and builders. Get your app discovered on the weekly showcase and earn community recognition.

news.title: App Agents
news.body: Base44's app agents now give every app a direct line to its users. Users can interact with your app's data and functionality through an automated agent — inside the app or across external messaging channels. These agents can answer, act, remember context, and connect to other tools your app needs. Set them up from the Agents tab in your app dashboard.

news.title: Base44 Accelerator: Cohort 1 Goes Public
news.body: Base44 kicked off its accelerator program today, with the first cohort of student founders going public.

news.title: Platform Migration
news.body: Base44 launched a platform migration feature — import projects from Salesforce, Shopify, WordPress, and more in a single click.

news.title: SEO & GEO for Your Apps
news.body: SEO and GEO scanning is built in. Run a full scan, get scored breakdowns for Google (SEO) and AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity (GEO), and click "Fix with AI" to patch missing meta tags, structured data, and more. Auto-generates llms.txt so AI search engines know what your app does. Live under the new Growth section.

news.title: GPT-5.5 on Base44
news.body: GPT-5.5 is now available on Base44. The latest model from OpenAI lets you tackle more complex tasks, faster.

news.title: Superagents Connect to iMessage
news.body: Superagents now connect to iMessage. Get things done without leaving your blue-bubble chats.

title: Grok
description: AI assistant by xAI — chat, reason, generate images, and analyze data with real-time information access.

news.title: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 end of life
news.body: grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 is deprecated and reaches end of life on October 2, 2026. All requests to that slug are routed to grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 at the same price, with higher accuracy. See the Speech to Text docs.

news.title: safety\_identifier request field
news.body: You can now send safety_identifier, an opaque end-user identifier assigned by your application, on Chat Completions, the Responses API, deferred chat completions, the Batch API, and the gRPC GetCompletionsRequest. It lets SpaceXAI attribute a policy violation to one of your end users rather than to your API key. The legacy user field is still accepted. See the Security FAQ.

media.alt: Audit log example
Audit log with filter by API keys
Audit log calendar filter

news.title: Multiple Accounts in Grok for iOS
news.body: The Grok iOS app now lets users add multiple accounts.

news.title: Grok 4.7
news.body: Grok 4.7, SpaceXAI's frontier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work, is now available on the xAI API as grok-4.7. It has a 500k context window, text and image inputs with text-only output, and no text output limit. Pricing is $2 / $0.50 / $6 per 1M tokens (input / cached input / output) below 200k prompt tokens, and $4 / news: [ / news: [2 above. Reasoning effort supports low, medium, high (default), and xhigh. On the Responses API, grok-4.7 always returns reasoning.encrypted_content, even when include does not list it. It is also served on the US regional endpoint. Grok 4.7 Fast, the same model at twice the token rates, is available only through Cursor and Grok Build, not on the public xAI API. See the Grok 4.7 overview and the announcement.

news.title: Introducing Grok 4.7
news.body: SpaceXAI launched Grok 4.7 for coding and knowledge work. The company says it works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and has stronger safeguards than Grok 4.6, while keeping the same price and speed. Its announcement also compares the two models building an open-world city game.

news.title: Grok 4.7 API Availability
news.body: Grok 4.7 is available through the Grok API and third-party coding tools and model routers. SpaceXAI lists pricing from $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens, the same as Grok 4.6.

news.title: Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0
news.body: grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 is now available. Use grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 or grok-voice-transcribe-2.0; the default is grok-voice-transcribe-1.0. See the Speech to Text docs.

news.title: Coinbase Connector in Grok
news.body: Grok can now trade and manage a portfolio on Coinbase. Add the Coinbase connector to check balances, analyze data, and place or cancel trades for available assets directly from chat.

news.title: Grok Bot Connects to GTM Tools
news.body: Grok Bot can now connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Granola, and other GTM tools. Stay on top of accounts, complete follow-ups, and do deep research from your bots.

news.title: grok-imagine-image-quality retirement on November 2
news.body: On November 2, 2026, grok-imagine-image-quality is retired. Requests to the slug will be served by grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low, with no change to the request or response shape and at a lower per-image price. grok-imagine-image (1.0) is not affected. See the migration guide.

news.title: Imagine image API updates
news.body: Auto quality. The quality parameter on grok-imagine-image-2.0 now accepts auto, and the default when quality is omitted has moved from medium to auto. Auto currently uses low for image generation and medium for image editing. Images are billed at the quality they are served at. Pass low or medium explicitly to pin a specific quality. See Image Generation. Five reference images. Image editing now accepts up to 5 source images per request (was 3). See Multi-Image Editing. New aspect ratios. Image generation and editing accept 21:9 (cinematic widescreen) and 5:2 (wide banners). See Image Generation.

news.title: Grok Bot
news.body: Grok Bot is now available. Durable AI teammates that work on a persistent cloud computer, with messaging, approvals, connectors, and routines. See the Grok Bot overview and Get started.

news.title: Grok 4.6
news.body: Grok 4.6 is available on Grok.com, iOS and Android. xAI suggests it for complex problems, agentic queries and building apps.

news.title: 21 New Voices on Grok
news.body: Meet 21 brand-new voices on Grok. Now available everywhere on iOS, Android, and web.

news.title: Connectors in Grok Voice Mode
news.body: Connectors are now available in Grok's Voice Mode. Ask Grok about your emails, check your daily meetings, or use any of your existing connectors, just by talking.

news.title: Workflows in Grok Build
news.body: Workflows are now in Grok Build. Hand Grok a task a single conversation can't hold, triage 100+ issues or review thousands of lines of code in detail. Build plans the work, runs up to hundreds of agents in parallel, and comes back with one report.

news.title: Figma Connector in Grok
news.body: The Figma connector is now in Grok.com and Grok Build — turn your designs into code, or diagram your codebase in FigJam.

news.title: Grok Voice Agent Builder
news.body: xAI introduced Voice Agent Builder — a no-code platform to create human-like voice agents with Grok Voice, from $0.05/min. It comes with telephony, knowledge retrieval, tools, guardrails, and observability, and works with your existing phone numbers, APIs, and MCPs. Every account gets a free phone number. Launching in beta.

news.title: Grok in Notion as MCP
news.body: Grok is now an MCP integration inside Notion — your timeline and your workspace in the same chat.

news.title: Voice Cloning via Grok API
news.body: xAI rolled out Voice Cloning via the Grok API — create custom voices in under 2 minutes or pick from 80+ preset voices across 28 languages.

news.title: X Communities Deprecated
news.body: XChat now supports joinable links for groupchats with 350 members per chat. X Communities is being deprecated May 6 due to declining usage. Custom Timelines investment continues.

news.title: Custom Timelines on X
news.body: Introducing Custom Timelines — pin a specific topic to your home tab. With 75+ topics, powered by Grok's understanding of every post with the algorithm's personalization. Every timeline is made just for you. Early access for Premium subscribers on iOS, Android coming soon.

title: Manus
description: Hands-on AI action engine — goes beyond answers to execute tasks, automate workflows, and extend your reach with agents that actually do the work.
features: Autonomous AI agent that executes tasks end-to-end

news.title: Introducing Manus 2.0
news.body: Manus 2.0 is a ground-up rebuild with a new Cascade agent harness, Cloud Computer and Automations, and Manus Studio, a shared workspace for docs, sheets, slides, sites, code, games, and video, including new Video Editor and Game Dev environments. It also introduces Cue, a personal-agent app with its own email, phone number, and wallet, and Remote Control to direct Manus from your phone.

news.title: Google Workspace Connector
news.body: Manus upgraded its Google Drive connector to a full Google Workspace connector: connect Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Forms through one connector. Set access levels before connecting, Off (Manus can't see it), Read (search and read only), or Full (read and write). Your files, your boundaries.

news.title: Auto-Publish for Sites
news.body: Manus added auto-publish: it deploys each successful build to your live URL automatically. Off by default so you control what goes public, and combined with queued changes, you can wake up to a finished site. The last manual step between building and shipping is gone.

news.title: PowerPoint Slides on Manus
news.body: Manus now generates .pptx directly, instead of building slides and converting them. That means editable charts that redraw when you change a value, toggles for labels, gridlines, and legends, and files you can download and open natively in PowerPoint.

news.title: Typst PDF Maker Skill
news.body: Manus added a /typst-pdf-maker skill: turn a single prompt into a professionally typeset PDF. Reports, research papers, resumes, even full books, with clean structure and layout handled automatically. Designed like you hired a typesetter.

news.title: Manus for Small Business
news.body: Manus launched Manus for Small Business — a toolkit with connectors, use cases, and ready-to-run workflows built for solopreneurs and small teams, plus live sessions to walk you through putting it to work.

news.title: Connect Semrush to Manus
news.body: You can now connect Semrush to Manus — pull SEO intelligence directly into your workflow: keyword research, competitor gap analysis, backlink profiles, and traffic intelligence, all from a prompt.

news.title: Shopify on Manus
news.body: Shopify is now on Manus — launch a store, manage your catalog, and run campaigns from one chat. Manus builds the storefront, Shopify handles checkout and fulfillment.

news.title: Projects Now on Mobile
news.body: Projects are now available on mobile in Manus. More than folders — shared instructions, files, project-specific skills, isolated connector setup, and scheduled tasks for reusable workflows. Organize and run project-based work wherever you are.

news.title: Scheduled Tasks 2.0
news.body: A major upgrade to recurring work in Manus. Scheduling is no longer just about running something at the right time — it's about running it in the right place, with the right context. Scheduled work can continue in the same task with persistent context.

news.title: Manus + Similarweb Data Integration
news.body: Manus unlocks richer growth intelligence with an upgraded Similarweb data integration. Access richer web intelligence directly inside Manus to understand what drives growth, not just who gets traffic.

news.title: Preferred Browser
news.body: Manus already works in your browser. Now it can keep working through the browser of your choice. Your web tasks get the right access, wherever you start.

news.title: Make a Copy for Website Projects
news.body: Manus added Make a Copy for Website projects — duplicate a Manus-built site before big changes, keeping the original untouched. Carries over the project foundation so you can test redesigns or templates in a separate session.

news.title: Self-Updating Projects
news.body: Manus Projects can now turn useful conversations into approved updates to project instructions and files — every task makes the next one better, with explicit approval before changes apply.

news.title: Recommended Connectors
news.body: Manus added recommended connectors — a curated set of integrations to plug Manus straight into the apps your agent should be acting on.

news.title: Manus Cloud Computer
news.body: Manus launched Cloud Computer — a hosted environment that lowers the barrier to building with autonomous agents. Spin one up and let your agent take over the keyboard.

news.title: GPT Image 2 in Manus Slides
news.body: Manus added GPT Image 2 to Manus Slides — point-and-click edits to text or visuals, swap elements with a prompt, and let Manus write your speaker notes.

title: Flora

news.title: Seedance 2.5 on FLORA
news.body: Seedance 2.5 is now on FLORA: 30-second generations with multi-shot storytelling, reference up to 30 images, 10 videos, and 10 audio clips in one pass, plus sharper motion and better character consistency.

news.title: Auto Model Select
news.body: FLORA introduced Auto Model Select — it evaluates what your request actually demands and routes it to the model proven best for that exact task, automatically, on every generation. Need more control? Toggle between "faster speed" and "better generation."

news.title: FLORA Gallery Page
news.body: FLORA launched a new gallery page — a centralized place to highlight the beautiful work creators are making inside FLORA. Tag FLORA to get your work featured on the page.

news.title: Unified Library
news.body: Stop shuffling through folders and websites for your assets. FLORA's Unified Library stores it all in one place: share it with teammates, organize it into folders, and simplify your asset library.

news.title: Reve 2.1 on FLORA
news.body: Reve 2.1 is now available on FLORA. Use it to create marketing materials, abstract patterns, or people, with more detail and precision in each render.

news.title: FLORA Timeline Editor
news.body: FLORA introduced the Timeline Editor — video editing controls right on the canvas. Generate, upscale, extend, cut, and render all in one place, with no more exporting to finish.

news.title: Gemini Omni Flash on FLORA
news.body: Google's Omni Flash is live on FLORA — use the next-gen video model today, all inside FLORA's canvas, powered by Google Cloud.

news.title: Bulk Rename
news.body: Flora shipped Bulk Rename — no more naming every asset Flower_v1_final_final. Set your naming your way and rename assets in bulk, every time.

news.title: Dropbox Connects to FLORA
news.body: Dropbox now connects to FLORA — import files straight from Dropbox onto the canvas, create, then export finished work back to your folders. It's all server-to-server, so there's nothing to download or re-upload.

news.title: Inpainting References Any Canvas Image
news.body: Inpainting can now reference any image on your canvas. @ mention it in your prompt: type @, pick an image, and the model paints with it as a reference — no more describing the look and hoping it works. Keep products, characters, and styles consistent, changing only what you need.

news.title: Google Drive
news.body: FLORA now connects directly to Google Drive — import source assets, run them through your workflows, and export back without downloading.

news.title: Ideogram 4.0 in FLORA
news.body: Ideogram 4.0 is now in FLORA.

news.title: Subtitles
news.body: Subtitles are now available in FLORA — enhance your videos without the manual effort.

news.title: Opus 4.8 in FLORA
news.body: Opus 4.8 is now live in FLORA.

news.title: FLORA MCP Is Live
news.body: FLORA MCP is live — connect it to your favorite AI assistant and use FLORA directly from a chat.

news.title: Krea 2 Now in FLORA
news.body: Krea 2 is now built into FLORA — for when "more better lighting" is not cutting it. Style transfer, moodboard input, and adjustable creativity settings.

news.title: Document Node Is Live
news.body: Your brief is now a node. Upload a PDF, connect it to any module, and generate text, image, and video outputs grounded in the document context. Document Node is live in FLORA.

news.title: Node Sharing
news.body: FLORA rolled out Node Sharing — send a single node for feedback instead of sharing the entire workflow.

news.title: Split Grid
news.body: FLORA added Split Grid — choose your grid size and watch generations land in place across the cells.

news.title: HEIC Uploads
news.body: FLORA now accepts HEIC uploads — drop iPhone photos straight onto the canvas, no conversion step.

news.title: Nano Banana 2 vs GPT Image 2
news.body: FLORA shared editorial test results showing Nano Banana 2 outperforming GPT Image 2 on lighting, model accuracy, and composition. Both free on FLORA until July 1.

news.title: Pricing Rebuilt in Dollars
news.body: FLORA rebuilt pricing in dollars (not credits) and pooled across teams. Free Nano Banana 2 + Pro through July 1.

news.title: Action Node
news.body: FLORA launched Action Node — point an LLM at any node in your canvas and have it act on the output, chaining reasoning and generation in a single flow.

news.title: Chainable Batch Nodes
news.body: Batch Node just got more powerful. Chain them together and generate every possible combination in a single run — scale your workflows with fewer nodes.

news.title: Composable Batch Nodes
news.body: If you've been pushing Batch Node, this is the upgrade. You can now compose two batches together so a full campaign runs as one workflow — models × wardrobes, products × backgrounds, every combination at once, live in FLORA.

news.title: GPT Image 2 in FLORA
news.body: GPT Image 2 is now in FLORA. Tested all three variants vs Nano Banana Pro across 13 dimensions before going live.

news.title: 360° Camera Control
news.body: Get every angle from one product shot. Camera control rotates around any image in a full 360. Use it on PDPs, campaign stills, lifestyle, whatever you shot last week. Now live in FLORA.

news.title: Techniques Built Into FAUNA
news.body: FAUNA now reaches for the right workflow automatically — one ask, and it picks the technique that fits the job.

news.title: Canvas Labels and Color-Coding
news.body: Add labels to the canvas, color-code, and make your workflow more legible to anyone.

Flora just launched Audio Node, which makes and processes sound natively inside FLORA, powered by ElevenLabs. Generate voiceovers, add foley to videos, clone voices, and lip sync — all without leaving your canvas.

title: Adobe Firefly Text to Speech
description: Generate natural-sounding voiceovers from text with Adobe Firefly — choose from multiple voices, languages, and styles.

features: Ableton Live — full DAW for production & performance
Note — iOS app for sketching ideas
Max for Live for custom devices
Learn Music & Learn Synths free in-browser

description: Royalty-free sample library — millions of sounds, FX, and presets from top artists, labels, and sound designers.

title: SketchUp

title: Maket
description: AI home design studio for generating floor plans, refining layouts, and visualizing rooms and homes in 3D.
features: Generate floor plans with AI or start from an uploaded plan
Refine layouts and rooms with plain-language instructions
Explore visual styles using a style library or reference images

title: Resolume
description: VJ software for live visuals — Avenue and Arena let you mix video, audio, and effects in real time.

title: Adobe Premiere: Video Editor
description: All-in-one mobile video editor from Adobe — cut, add text & audio, use templates from top creators, and animate with keyframes.

news.title: Premiere Mobile Launches on Android
news.body: Adobe Premiere mobile is now available for Android through the Google Play Store, bringing its mobile video editing tools to another platform.

media.alt: Adobe announcement video for Premiere mobile on Android

news.title: Crop and Beat Detection in Premiere on iPhone
news.body: Crop and Beat Detection in Premiere on iPhone make an elite combo. Try the latest features in-app today.

title: SimTheory

title: MagicBrief

features: Creative analytics across Meta, TikTok, YouTube & LinkedIn

title: Lovart
description: AI design agent that creates production-ready visuals from prompts — logos, illustrations, social posts, and brand assets.

news.title: Lovart MCP Is Live on Codex
news.body: Lovart’s MCP integration is now available in Codex. It lets creators bring brand context into their workflow, produce creative assets in batches, and ask for guidance on which versions may perform best. Lovart says the integration is powered by Jev.

media.alt: Lovart demonstration of its MCP integration with Codex

news.title: ChatGPT Images 2.5 on Lovart
news.body: ChatGPT Images 2.5 is now on Lovart with Smart Sketch for turning scribbles into detailed scenes, Sharp Vector for scaling designs to any display, and Precise Edit for pinpoint changes without losing quality.

news.title: Seedance 2.5 on Lovart
news.body: The wait is over: Seedance 2.5 is now on Lovart. Native 30-second 4K output straight from the model, up to 50 reference assets to lock in consistency, and pixel-perfect control down to every frame.

news.title: MiniMax H3 on Lovart
news.body: MiniMax H3, the world's #2 video model, just landed on Lovart — production-quality AI video at less than half the cost. 15s cinematic output with fluid, high-fidelity motion, multimodal references across text, image, video, and audio, and consistent characters, products, scenes, and styles.

news.title: Nano Banana 2 Lite on Lovart
news.body: Nano Banana 2 Lite is live on Lovart — 4-second image generation at warp speed, with exceptional value.

news.title: Gemini Omni Flash on Lovart
news.body: Gemini Omni Flash is now live on Lovart to transform your creative workflow.

news.title: Introducing Lovart Mockup
news.body: Lovart Mockup puts your logo, label, or poster on a real-world object in seconds — no mockup files, no Photoshop, just place and preview.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 Mini on Lovart
news.body: Seedance 2.0 Mini is live on Lovart — low cost with serious all-around power, built to produce full series and ad campaigns in batches. Prototype with Mini, then polish on the full model.

news.title: Lovart × Gemini Omni Flash
news.body: Lovart × Gemini Omni Flash — coming soon.

news.title: Create Skill
news.body: Launching Create Skill on Lovart — turn your best conversations into reusable workflows, recreate exact workflows across projects, and build a custom library of automated workflows.

news.title: Kling 3.0 4K Live on Lovart
news.body: Kling 3.0 4K is now live on Lovart — the world's first native 4K video model. Optimized for large screens and pro workflows. Native 4K with stable subject, style, color, and mood. Cinema-grade texture and professional performance.

news.title: GPT Image 2 on Lovart
news.body: Unlimited 2K GPT Image 2 Standard Generations. Near-perfect text rendering, ultra-realistic artifact-free textures.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 Native 1080p on Lovart
news.body: Seedance 2.0 now native 1080p. Enhanced motion clarity, cinematic quality, razor-sharp edges and flicker-free textures for pro-level viewing.

news.title: Font Generator
news.body: New Feature: Font Generator. One-click creation of unique fonts from images, text, or hybrid inputs. Canvas-ready and auto-stored in your My Fonts library.

news.title: PSD Export for AI Designs
news.body: Lovart added PSD export — take any AI-generated design out as a fully editable, multi-layer Photoshop file.

title: OpenArt
description: AI art platform — generate images from text, train custom models, edit with inpainting, and create consistent characters.

news.title: OpenArt Arena Leaderboard for Creative Intelligence
news.body: OpenArt launched OpenArt Arena, which it calls the global leaderboard for creative intelligence. Creative professionals evaluate the leading AI image and video models blindly across the work creators actually care about, with separate boards for ads, film, animation, motion design, video editing, lip sync, e-commerce, graphic design and image editing.

news.title: Introducing OpenArt CLI
news.body: OpenArt is now available in the terminal. Use the OpenArt CLI with Claude Code, Codex, and other command-line assistants to generate images and videos where you work, or automate batch generations with scripts.

news.title: Turn Any URL Into a Video
news.body: OpenArt can now turn any URL into a video. Paste a product page, property listing, website, or any other link into chat mode and describe what you want to create — from an ad or walkthrough to a promo or story.

news.title: Lyric Video
news.body: Lyric Video turns a song into a finished lyric video in OpenArt. Upload the track, pick a look, decide how the words move, and add your own images or video; Director assembles the rest around the lyrics.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash on OpenArt
news.body: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash is live on OpenArt with more control over where a video starts and ends. First and last frames set both ends of the clip, scene extension carries a story to 40 seconds, and up to three seconds of reference video can guide the look, character, scene or movement. Generate at 360p while testing, then finish at 1080p or 4K.

news.title: Viral Presets Powered by Seedance 2.5
news.body: The internet's favorite presets just got an upgrade: Viral Presets powered by Seedance 2.5. Choose a preset, upload your image, and generate a 30-second viral video in seconds. Available now on OpenArt.

news.title: FLUX.3 Text to Video on OpenArt
news.body: FLUX.3 Text to Video is now on OpenArt. Turn a text prompt into expressive video with native audio, multilingual dialogue, and sounds that respond to the scene.

news.title: Seedance 2.5 Live on OpenArt, Unlimited for 7 Days
news.body: Seedance 2.5 is live on OpenArt, and for the next 7 days generations are unlimited. Create native 30-second videos with better realism, precision editing, and up to 50 reference assets.

news.title: Introducing Ad Remake
news.body: OpenArt introduced Ad Remake: found an ad you love? Upload it, and OpenArt recreates it with your own product, brand, characters, style, and language. Keep the concept, make it yours, and create endless variations.

news.title: Run Creative Production From Your Agent
news.body: Your AI agent can now run your creative production with OpenArt MCP. Upload one product photo and your agent generates banners, social creatives, product images, and video ads, all inside Claude, with no tool switching and no API keys. Just tell it what you need. Check it out at openart.ai/mcp.

news.title: Brand Kit
news.body: You rebuild your brand every time you generate. What if you didn't have to? Brand Kit saves your logo, colors, style, tone, and rules once, then it shows up automatically on every image and video you make. Brand Kit is live on OpenArt. Start on-brand, every time.

news.title: Video Remix in OpenArt Director
news.body: Video Remix is live in OpenArt Director. Upload any video you love as inspiration, remix it with chat, and own the final version.

news.title: Gemini Omni Flash in OpenArt
news.body: Gemini Omni Flash is now live in OpenArt — edit videos through natural conversation, grounded in real-world knowledge (physics, history, science), and reference images, text, video, or audio to build one cohesive scene.

news.title: Introducing OpenArt Director
news.body: OpenArt introduced OpenArt Director and a new way to create: Vibe Directing. Describe what you want, chat it into perfection, and walk away with professional-quality video from just an idea and a conversation.

news.title: OpenArt MCP
news.body: Meet OpenArt MCP — one connection to all the top models (Seedance 2.0, GPT Image 2, Kling 3 Omni), and the only connector with access to your full OpenArt library. Works inside Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

news.title: VFX
news.body: OpenArt VFX lets you apply real visual effects to footage — mask any region of your video and replace it with AI-generated content matching the scene's lighting and physics.

news.title: Characters with Voices
news.body: A character isn't just how they look — it's also how they sound. Introducing Characters with Voices on OpenArt: clone your own voice, design one from a text description, or choose from the library. Attach it to your character once and it follows them across every workflow.

news.title: Projects and Folders
news.body: The more you create, the harder it gets to stay organized. Projects and Folders are now inside OpenArt — so every image, generation, and creative asset has a home. Structure your workspace by client, by campaign, by vibe. Keep your best work accessible.

news.title: OpenArtist Program
news.body: OpenArt launched the OpenArtist Program — a path for creators to grow their reach, get early access to new models, and partner with OpenArt on launches.

news.title: Smart Shot — Cinematic Scenes from One Sentence
news.body: Introducing Smart Shot, powered by GPT Image-2 and Seedance 2.0. One sentence becomes a complete cinematic scene: full shot plan (characters, environment, storyboard, camera), multi-cut video (wide, close-up, cutaways), consistent characters across every frame, 10-20 seconds and production-ready.

news.title: Kling 3.0 — Native 4K Video on OpenArt
news.body: Kling 3.0 is live on OpenArt — the first AI model with native 4K video, no upscaling. Production-ready visuals from a single prompt, built for ads, film, and broadcast. Consistent subjects, clean text, controlled lighting, all at native resolution.

news.title: Multi View
news.body: Drop in any image and it generates multiple shots — close-ups, mood shots, lifestyle scenes, alternate perspectives. Every direction your image could go, from a single input. Now live on OpenArt.

news.title: GPT Image 2 on OpenArt
news.body: OpenAI's newest image model — built for real creative work. Readable text, designed layouts, cleaner edits, reference-driven consistency, cinematic control.

news.title: Music Generation with Google Lyria 3
news.body: Music generation is live on OpenArt, powered by Google Lyria 3. Prompt it, reference your image, or both. Image, video, and music — all in one place.

news.title: LTX-2.3 Now Live on OpenArt
news.body: The most capable open video model just got a major upgrade. Sharper fine detail (hair, textures, text, edges), tighter prompt adherence for complex multi-subject prompts, and more.

title: Higgsfield
description: AI video and image generation platform — create videos, edit with motion control, swap faces, and collaborate in real time.

news.title: Ad Multiplier
news.body: Recreate any video ad with your own characters, products, and locations from one reference, now with a visual interface on Higgsfield. Upload an ad, add your assets, and describe the new scene. Ad Multiplier keeps the original's structure and swaps in what you specify. What you can change: product, cast, location, script, hook, or CTA. Mention attached files in the prompt with @. Hooks and CTAs: try as many as you want without re-uploading the reference. References: one video from 4 to 30 seconds and up to 20 images. Quality: 480p, 720p, or 1080p. To get started: open Ads Studio → Ad Multiplier → upload a reference video → Generate.

news.title: Nano Banana 2.1
news.body: Google's update to Nano Banana 2 is now available on Higgsfield, with the same speed and output up to 4K. Compared with Nano Banana 2, it improves visual quality, prompt adherence, character consistency across edits, and text rendering, per Google. References: up to 14 images, with consistency for up to 4 characters and up to 10 objects. Text edits: describe what to change, such as a shirt color, and the model edits that part of the image. Wide formats: fixed tiling artifacts on 1:4, 4:1, 1:8, and 8:1 at 2K and 4K. Resolution: 1K by default, 2K, or 4K. To get started: Image → model selector → Nano Banana 2.1.

news.title: Higgsfield Global Film Festival dates updated
news.body: The festival timeline has been extended to allow more time to review all submissions. Shortlist and Audience Choice voting: October 8, 2026. Jury review: October 9–14. Winners: announced in the last week of October. See the current dates on the Festival Timeline.

news.title: Seedance generation failures resolved
news.body: A provider-side issue caused failed and slow generations, mostly on 2.0, 2.0 Mini, 2.0 Fast, and 2.5 Draft Mode. All models are running normally again. Credits for failed generations were refunded automatically, so you can run them again at no extra cost. Sorry for the disruption.

news.title: AI Influencer
news.body: Build your own AI character, then bring it into videos on Higgsfield. Starting point: create a character from scratch, from a reference, or from your own photo with Add your face. Character Builder: 19 categories, from character type and age to style and accessories. Shuffle picks a random set. Videos: click Use in Genjutsu to put your character into an existing video with Motion transfer or Object swap. Free generations: 5 for every user to try it, as of October 3, 2026. To get started: open AI Influencer → Character Builder → Generate.

news.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5
news.body: xAI's new video model, with sound generated in the same pass as motion, is now available on Higgsfield. Modes: image-to-video, text-to-video, reference-to-video, and video extension. Video extension: continue a clip from its last frame, keeping the character, lighting, and motion consistent. References: up to 7 images to keep a character or style consistent across generations. Output: 480p, 720p, or 1080p; 1 to 15 seconds; 24 fps. To get started: Video → model selector → Grok Imagine Video 1.5.

news.title: Ideogram 4.5 Is Live on Higgsfield
news.body: Ideogram 4.5 is now available on Higgsfield. The image model is designed for precise, high-resolution edits: change text, products, colors, lighting, or a single detail while keeping the rest of the image intact.

news.title: FLUX 3 Image
news.body: A new model for creating and editing images is now available on Higgsfield. It's part of the multimodal FLUX 3 family. Compared with earlier versions, it follows complex prompts more closely, renders text more accurately in multiple languages, and makes more precise edits, per Black Forest Labs. Modes: text-to-image and image-to-image. Styles: photo, illustration, poster, collage, and editorial. Resolution: 768p, 1K, 1.5K, 2K, or 4K, with native rendering at 2K and 4K. To get started: Image → model selector → FLUX 3 Image.

news.title: Ads Studio
news.body: Turn a link to your website into static ad creatives with your brand, products, and design on Higgsfield. Brand setup: set your logo, colors, tone of voice, audience, and selling points once, then reuse them in every batch. Products: pick products from your site, or add them by link or manually. Batches: up to 20 ads per product at a time. Chat: use Mention a product to generate more ads for a product in your project. To get started: open Ads Studio.

news.title: Ideogram 4.5
news.body: A new image model built for editing is now available on Higgsfield. Edit the same image repeatedly while colors, textures, and details stay in place, per Ideogram. Reference edits: transfer a style or element from up to 4 reference images. Text edits: replace or translate text in a design with a prompt, keeping the layout. Transparent background: add "transparent background" to your prompt to generate without one. Resolution: 1K or 2K. To get started: Image → model selector → Ideogram 4.5.

news.title: Genjutsu Restyle
news.body: Redraw a whole video in a new visual style on Higgsfield, keeping the original motion, timing, and camera work. It works in Genjutsu's Motion transfer mode, with reference videos from 4 to 30 seconds. Styles: 20+ animation styles, or build your own from reference images. References: up to 30 images of characters, products, or clothing. Resolution: 480p, 720p, or 1080p. To get started: Video → Higgsfield Genjutsu → Styles. Availability: on the web and via MCP.

news.title: Higgsfield extension for ChatGPT
news.body: Generate images, video, branded content, and websites right in ChatGPT, built on OpenAI's new extensions feature. Slash commands: /effects for Viral Presets, /product, /motion, and /marketing-studio for Marketing Studio, and /genjutsu for Genjutsu. Ads and UGC: product ads, video ads, UGC videos, and Ad Multiplier variations from one photo or video. Sites and games: build, publish, and update websites, web apps, and browser games in the chat. To get started: install the Higgsfield plugin.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 generation failures and Seedance 2.5 delays resolved
news.body: Generations failed more often than usual on 2.0 and took longer to complete on 2.5 because of a provider-side issue. Both models are running normally again. If any of your generations failed, you can run them again. Sorry for the disruption.

news.title: OpenAI Dots
news.body: Always-on AI agents in ChatGPT can now generate video and images on Higgsfield through the Higgsfield plugin. Each dot runs on GPT-6.1 Sol with its own cloud computer, per OpenAI. Higgsfield tools: Cinema Studio, Genjutsu, Marketing Studio, and more. Chat: ChatGPT, Slack, and Teams. Set up your first dot on desktop. To get started: install the Higgsfield plugin. Availability: ChatGPT Pro and Business Premium in supported regions, plus Enterprise, Edu, and Healthcare when an admin turns on Dots.

news.title: GPT-6.1 Sol
news.body: GPT-6.1 Sol, OpenAI's upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, is now available in Supercomputer on Higgsfield. It's a text model for code and agentic tasks, and Supercomputer uses Orchestrator by default, so select GPT-6.1 Sol manually to use it. Compared with GPT-6 Sol, per OpenAI: Coding: better in real codebases, close to GPT-6 Astra on long engineering tasks. Documents: more accurate answers on complex PDFs with tables, charts, diagrams, and small print. Computer use: works better with desktop apps, with results close to GPT-6 Astra. Science: stronger at data analysis, simulations, and terminal work. For the hardest research tasks, OpenAI still recommends GPT-6 Astra. To get started: open Supercomputer → model selector → GPT-6.1 Sol.

news.title: Eleven v4
news.body: Eleven v4, ElevenLabs' new text-to-speech model, is now available in Audio on Higgsfield. It adapts delivery to the text, from dramatic to soft, urgent, or humorous, while keeping a consistent voice, per ElevenLabs. Multiple speakers: several voices in one generation, for dialogues, podcasts, and scenes. Delivery control: follows tags and delivery prompts more closely than earlier ElevenLabs models, per ElevenLabs. Languages: 90+, with the native accent held for the whole generation. Length: up to 10,000 characters per generation. To get started: open Audio → model selector → Eleven v4.

news.title: Credit reset: up to 2,000 free credits
news.body: Subscribers on Higgsfield get their credit balance topped up to their plan's full monthly amount. The offer ends September 30, 2026, at 23:59 UTC. Unused bonus credits expire at that time. Eligibility: All paid plans. Upgrades don't add bonus credits. Bonus credits: Shown separately in your credit balance and spent first. Canceled plans: If your plan is still active, you can resume it and get the reset on the same terms. To get started: claim your bonus credits in Manage Account → Subscription.

news.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
news.body: Claude Sonnet 5.5, the new version of Anthropic's Sonnet model, is now available in Supercomputer on Higgsfield. Speed: more than 30% faster output than Claude Sonnet 5, with fewer tokens for the same work, per Anthropic. Coding: stronger than Claude Sonnet 5 at agentic coding, including building websites and apps and fixing bugs, per Anthropic. Best for: well-defined tasks like docs, slides, spreadsheets, and quick iterations. For complex, open-ended work, use Claude Opus 5.5. To get started: open Supercomputer → model selector → Claude Sonnet 5.5.

news.title: Mobile interface redesign
news.body: Higgsfield on mobile now opens on the prompt bar, with navigation moved to a sidebar. Features are unchanged; only their placement has moved. Agent tab: popular scenarios, including Genjutsu, GPT-6 Astra, Create Image, and Create Video. Sidebar: opens from the top-left icon, with New Chat, Explore, MCP, Higgsfield Genjutsu, Community, and Library. Recent Chats: below the main sidebar items. Profile: at the bottom of the sidebar, with your credit balance and account details.

news.title: Higgsfield API cashback
news.body: Higgsfield API returns news: [ in cashback for every news: [ spent on API usage, valid until September 30, 23:59 UTC. Cashback is earned on API usage paid from your main balance, not on top-ups. The campaign ends early if the $20M pool runs out, and unused cashback expires at the deadline. Limit: up to news: [,000 per account; verify a business email and add a card to raise it to $200,000. How it's spent: cashback pays first when it covers a generation's full cost; otherwise your main balance pays and earns cashback. Discounts: generations paid with cashback use standard prices, without model discounts. To get started: top up in the API console and use the API as usual.

news.title: Production Skills Bundle
news.body: The Production Skills Bundle adds 11 Higgsfield workflows for Claude MCP that run inside Blender, Adobe apps, TouchDesigner, and DaVinci Resolve Studio. The agent works in your installed software and returns an editable project. Claude Desktop and the software need to be on the same computer. 3D (Blender): Destruction Studio, Exploded View, Scene Builder, Cartoon Shaders. Editing and VFX (Premiere Pro, After Effects): Project Sorter, Shot Composer, Shot Cleanup. Design (Illustrator, Photoshop): Vectorize, Image Fixer. Effects and color (TouchDesigner, DaVinci Resolve Studio): TouchDesigner Effects, Color Grading. To get started: connect Higgsfield MCP in Claude Desktop → open the Production Skills Bundle → Try in Claude.

news.title: Native 1080p Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield API
news.body: Higgsfield announced native 1080p Seedance 2.5 on its API, including US availability. It also advertised 100% instant cashback on API spend, with up to $200,000 per business or $1,000 per individual. Higgsfield said $18 million remained in the first-come pool at the time of the announcement, and unused cashback expires September 30.

news.title: Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode. Preview before the final
news.body: Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode is a new model in Seedance video generation for drafting before the final. Generate previews at 480p, pick the take that works, then generate that one at 1080p on Seedance 2.5. 480p drafts: check composition, motion, pacing, and audio-visual timing; adjust the prompt and references before the final. 1080p final: run the selected draft's prompt, references, seed, aspect ratio, and duration on Seedance 2.5. Availability: all regions except the US, where the model is unavailable on the provider's side. To get started: Video → model selector → Seedance 2.5 Draft Mode.

news.title: Seedream 5.0 Flash. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: Seedream 5.0 Flash is a new model in Seedream image line: fast image generation with intelligent visual reasoning. Resolution: 1K, 1.5K, and 2K. Multi-reference: add several references and the model blends their style in one frame. Generation and editing: create from scratch or fix an existing image without switching models. To get started: Image → model selector → Seedream 5.0 Flash.

news.title: Claude Opus 5.5 on Higgsfield
news.body: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available in Higgsfield Supercomputer and through the Higgsfield MCP in Claude. Pair the model’s reasoning with Higgsfield’s creative tools to build complete products. Higgsfield says Opus 5.5 is 40% cheaper and over 30% faster than Opus 5.

media.alt: Higgsfield demonstration of Claude Opus 5.5

news.title: Preview Mode for Seedance 2.5
news.body: Seedance 2.5 Preview Mode lets you generate 480p drafts, compare takes, and refine camera movement, action, and timing before rendering your chosen take at 1080p. The selected draft carries its prompt, references, seed, aspect ratio, and duration into the final render. Higgsfield says the model is unavailable in the US on the provider’s side.

media.alt: Higgsfield demonstration of Seedance 2.5 Preview Mode

news.title: GPT Image 2.5. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: GPT Image 2.5, OpenAI's new image model, is live in two variants. GPT Image 2.5 Flare: the default for most tasks. Higher quality than GPT Image 2 at up to 50% lower latency. GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst: for precise control in edits; generation takes longer. Across both: sharper detail, better subject preservation from references, targeted edits that don't degrade across iterations, and stronger style holding. To get started: Image → model selector → GPT Image 2.5 Flare or Sunburst.

news.title: Introducing AI Motion Designer
news.body: AI Motion Designer is a new agent that connects Higgsfield to Adobe After Effects through GPT. Generate visuals in Higgsfield, describe the motion work in text, and the agent builds it in your open AE composition: titles, logo reveals, transitions, promos, effects. Works from your material and references; translates the request into layers, keyframes, and timing. Resolution (1080p to 8K) and duration are set in the prompt. Output is native AE elements, editable as usual. To get started: install the Higgsfield plugin in ChatGPT and type /use-after-effects. Requirements: active Higgsfield, GPT, and After Effects subscriptions; generations use your regular credits.

news.title: Effects 2.0. Viral presets in ChatGPT
news.body: Effects 2.0 is live in the ChatGPT plugin, running on GPT-6 Astra: upload a photo and get a video in one of the viral preset styles, in the chat. Run effects: type @Higgsfield /effects and upload a photo. Call a preset by name: @Higgsfield /main-character, /brand-monument, and others. Browse the library or apply a preset to your reference. The plugin also covers image and video generation, branding and product graphics, Ad Multiplier, UGC and faceless video, motion graphics, and building websites through chat. To get started: open the Higgsfield plugin in ChatGPT and type /effects.

news.title: Presets for After Effects
news.body: The presets run on GPT Astra paired with Higgsfield through the ChatGPT plugin: seven motion workflows, each with a ready prompt, a workflow breakdown, and a Try in ChatGPT button. Also available as the Motion Design Bundle in one set. Presets: Illustration Animation, Localization Motion, Motion Design, Paper Collage, Presentation Animation, SaaS Animation, Whiteboard Animation. To get started: select a preset from the Presets Library and hit Try in ChatGPT.

news.title: Higgsfield API is here
news.body: Higgsfield API is a standalone product for developers: one key opens 50+ frontier models for image, video, and audio. You send a prompt; Higgsfield handles the queue, GPUs, and scaling, and returns a link to the file. Pay per generation. No subscriptions or seats; public per-model rates, only successful generations are billed. Separate from higgsfield.ai plans and credits. Three calls: submit a prompt, poll the status, fetch the file. SDKs for Python and TypeScript, or plain REST. Launch offer: 15% off all models, up to 50% off on 4 models of your choice. To get started: create a key at Higgsfield API.

news.title: Claude Opus 5.5. New in Supercomputer
news.body: Claude Opus 5.5, the new version of Anthropic's Opus model, is now in Supercomputer. Stronger than Opus 5 in agentic coding, long multi-step tasks, and knowledge work: reports, analysis, financial models. More efficient: it completes typical tasks using fewer tokens. Clearer output: reports on what it did, found, and needs next in plain language, with less filler. Better visual reading: charts, diagrams, and screenshots parse more accurately, and computer use at default effort matches Opus 5 on high. To get started: open Supercomputer and select Claude Opus 5.5.

GPT-6 Sol: the workhorse of the line, for complex coding, agentic tasks, long multi-step scenarios, and tool use. GPT-6 Luna: the cheapest model in the family, for simple, high-volume tasks. GPT-6 Astra stays the flagship, for when you need the strongest result. To get started: install the ChatGPT Plugin, or open Supercomputer and select GPT-6 Sol or GPT-6 Luna.

news.title: Introducing Higgsfield API
news.body: Higgsfield API brings 50+ frontier models into one API at lower prices than a subscription. Get up to 50% off your three favorite models, lock in your maximum discount within 7 days, and pay per use with no commitment. Available at open.higgsfield.ai.

news.title: Higgsfield App Contest. $100,000 for the best apps
news.body: To celebrate the Higgsfield Apps launch, the App Contest is live with a $100,000 prize pool. Build and publish an original app in Supercomputer, any theme, from productivity tools and games to image and video generators, as long as people want to generate in it. Prizes. 1st: $25,000 · 2nd: $15,000 · 3rd: $10,000 · 10 honorable mentions: $5,000 each. Dates. Entries July 8, 8:00 AM PT – July 22, 2026, 8:00 AM PT. Judging July 22–29. Winners announced July 29. Judging. Credit Spend inside the app, creativity and concept, social engagement, and activity on Higgsfield. To get started: build and publish an app in Supercomputer, then share it on social media with a link and the #HiggsfieldApp hashtag to complete your entry. Availability: 18+, free to enter with a Higgsfield account. Apps must be original, published July 8 or later, and use Higgsfield model generation, apps running generation through third-party APIs are disqualified.

news.title: AI Motion Designer for After Effects
news.body: Higgsfield introduced AI Motion Designer, a ChatGPT plugin for motion design in After Effects. It understands animation principles, writes expressions, and retains context across your After Effects projects.

news.title: Introducing 3D Jutsu
news.body: 3D Jutsu is an AI-native 3D workspace from Higgsfield that works together with Supercomputer. Turns a prompt or reference into an editable 3D scene, with objects, layout, lighting, cameras, and animation, and then into video. Edits individual objects in the scene without regenerating everything. Organize shots and generate finished video in one shared workspace. How it works Describe what you want in a prompt and pick a model, GPT-6 Astra included. Get a draft scene: move characters and objects, place cameras, adjust lighting. Build it all together with the AI agent. To get started: open 3D Jutsu.

news.title: GPT-6 Astra. Now in Supercomputer
news.body: GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's new flagship model, is now available in Supercomputer. Holds multi-step workflows and produces finished documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. Follows prompts closely, with clearly structured slides. Pulls only relevant context into the output, without repetition, so results are usable as is. Stronger visual judgment for sites, games, apps, and renders. To get started: open Supercomputer and select GPT-6 Astra.

news.body: Scale, our Business plan for teams of 5 to 15, now includes unlimited models. Existing subscribers keep their original terms; the changes apply to new subscriptions. Unlimited models on Scale Monthly plan: Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5.0 Pro. Annual plan: Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5.0 Pro, and Kling 3.0. news.title: Claude Fable 5.1. Now in Supercomputer
news.body: Claude Fable 5.1, a new Anthropic model and the successor to Claude Fable 5, is now available in Supercomputer. Stronger on long agentic tasks: coding, multi-step research, and document work. Improved writing: clearer, more coherent, and more accurate at following guidelines. Adaptive thinking is always on; set reasoning depth with the effort selector. To get started: open Supercomputer and select Claude Fable 5.1.
