news.title: Introducing Genjutsu
news.body: Genjutsu is a new video tool from Higgsfield that changes an object, location, product, or character in a video while leaving everything else as it was. No prompt needed: pick from 30+ presets or briefly describe the change. Motion Transfer: take the motion from any video and build a new scene around it. Object Swap: change exactly what you describe; the rest of the frame stays untouched. Inputs: one video (up to 30 seconds) and up to 30 reference photos. Output up to 1080p. To get started: Video → model selector → choose Genjutsu.

news.title: MiniMax H3 Max. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: MiniMax H3 Max is live, a post-trained variant of MiniMax H3 tuned for prompt adherence and aesthetics. Text-to-video: generate video from a text description of setting, subject, action, and camera. Image-to-video: animate a source image, keeping composition, identity, and aspect ratio. Directed frame transitions: set a start and end frame to control the scene. Built for speed over resolution: caps at 768p, where base H3 reaches 2K. To get started: Video → model selector → choose MiniMax H3 Max.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash is live, Google's multimodal model for video generation and editing. First and last frames: set a starting and ending frame, and the model generates everything in between. Draft mode: test ideas at 360p, cheaper and faster, then upscale the takes you keep. Up to 10 seconds per generation, at 360p, 720p, 1080p, or 4K. Best for: transitions and camera moves between two set frames, and fast, low-cost iteration before a final render.To get started: Video → model selector → choose Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash.

news.title: FLUX 3 Video Upscaler. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: FLUX 3 Video Upscaler raises the resolution of video while keeping motion smooth and audio in sync. It accepts any input video and outputs at 1080p, 2K, or 4K. Two modes Precise. Raises resolution without adding new detail. Creative. Adds and reworks detail, with an optional prompt (detail guidance) to steer what gets changed. To get started: open Upscale and upload a video.

news.title: Higgsfield MCP. Fixed
news.body: Higgsfield MCP calls were failing earlier on August 27. Resolved, and MCP is working normally again.

news.title: Recraft V4. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: Three new Recraft image models are live: V4.1, Styles, and Utility. Recraft V4.1. The main model. Varies light, mood, and composition across generations. Recraft Styles. Style transfer by reference. Attach up to 10 references and following generations match that style. No training required. Recraft Utility. Flat light, frontal composition, simple scenes. For mockups and product shots. To get started: Image → model selector → Recraft.

news.title: Higgsfield Apps. Back online
news.body: Apps in Supercomputer are back up and running normally.

news.title: GLM-5.3 Flash replaces Ox Alpha in Supercomputer
news.body: Ox Alpha's stealth period has ended: it's now revealed as GLM-5.3 Flash and costs credits. The same model is available in Supercomputer under its real name. A fast, lightweight model from Zhipu AI's GLM line. Tuned for speed and low cost, suited to chat, code, and general tasks where quick responses matter. To get started: open Supercomputer and select GLM-5.3 Flash.

news.title: Higgsfield Global Film Festival. Deadlines extended
news.body: Create in Public deadline: now September 12 Final submission deadline: now September 14 All following dates shift accordingly. See the festival page for the full timeline.

news.title: Ad Multiplier. New skill for Claude
news.body: Ad Multiplier turns one video ad into many variants: same video, edit, and pacing, with new characters, clothing, locations, and objects. Runs through the Higgsfield MCP connector. Same video, new details. Swap one element or all of them per variant; performance, cut, and pacing are preserved. Original audio kept on every non-translated variant. Captions can be removed, or regenerated in another language on request (with a synthetic voiceover). To get started: connect Higgsfield to Claude via MCP.

news.title: Affiliate Program. Now live
news.body: Share and earn commission on every plan bought through your link. Commission up to 25% on qualifying subscriptions, paid to your card. Recurring for up to 12 months on qualifying renewals. Referral discount. Anyone who signs up through your link gets up to 50% off for three hours. Referral tracking. See which subscriptions and commissions are attributed to your link. To get started: apply at Higgsfield to get your link.

news.title: Ox Alpha. Free in Supercomputer
news.body: Ox Alpha, a new reasoning model, is now free in Supercomputer. Built for code, long multi-step tasks, and large context. Reasoning. Built for coding, sustained agentic work, and production tasks, with step-by-step logic across long jobs. Large context. A roughly 1M-token context window for working over large amounts of material in one session. Multimodal. Accepts text, image, and video input, and returns text. Tool calling and structured output. Calls external tools and supports JSON-formatted output, useful for automation. To get started: open Supercomputer and select Ox Alpha in the model selector.

news.title: Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime. Now on Higgsfield
news.body: The newest Wan video models are live, generating video from text and images. Up to 30 seconds per generation, at 480p, 720p, or 1080p. Multi-subject consistency: faces, clothing, and details stay stable across frames, even with several characters. Audio sync, with improved handling of physics and facial expression. Wan 3.0 Prime generates faster than earlier models, including standard 3.0, at a higher cost. Best for: social media content, product and ad creatives, and film previz. To get started: Video → model selector → choose Wan 3.0 or Wan 3.0 Prime.

news.title: Projects. Now in Supercomputer
news.body: Projects is a shared workspace in Supercomputer that keeps context across your work. Teamwork. Share a project with others; instructions are shared, but each person's chats and memory stay private. Project skills and connectors. Add skills and connectors to a project, where they take priority over all others. Project memory. Kept separate from personal memory, so nothing personal carries in or out. Assets and Elements. Store documents in the project; uploaded images and videos become named Elements. To get started: open Supercomputer and create a project.

news.title: Grok Bot. Now in Higgsfield MCP
news.body: Grok Bot by xAI is now in Higgsfield MCP. Unlike a chatbot, it's built on always-on AI agents that carry out multi-step tasks on their own. Each bot runs on its own cloud computer with a browser, file system, and terminal. It logs into your tools and apps and completes multi-step tasks end to end, even when your device is off. To get started: head to Higgsfield MCP, install Grok Bot, then add the Higgsfield plugin and sign in. Once connected, just ask it to generate an image or video. New users: verify a card to start the MCP 3-day trial and get 100 MCP-only credits. If not cancelled before the end of the trial, it renews as a monthly Plus Plan.

news.title: Higgsfield. Now in Blender
news.body: Higgsfield is now available inside Blender, the 3D editor for modeling, animation, and rendering, with generation and scene work built right into the plugin. Tools: Scene Builder, 3D Model, Character Animation, Image and Video, and Camera. How to install: download the .zip from the plugin page, drag it onto any open Blender window (it installs and enables itself), then open the Higgsfield panel, log in, and start generating.

news.title: Higgsfield Relight and HEX for videos. Now standalone products
news.body: Relight and Color Palette are now available as standalone video-editing products. Same functionality as in Cinema Studio 4.0, now also usable on their own. Relight Six presets: Silhouette, Practicals, Window, Overhead Fall, Contre-jour, and Soft Cross, plus Auto. Or build your own with control over color, brightness, diffusion, and angle. Add up to two custom light sources. Color Palette 50+ color-grading presets, including Film Colors, Black Gloss, Candy Pink, Lime Jam, Nostalgic Blue, Soft Palette, Overtime, and Crimson Vigil. Plus custom grading. To get started: open Relight or Color Palette.

news.title: Faceless Studio. Out now
news.body: Faceless Studio is now a standalone product (previously a Supercomputer skill). It generates animated faceless videos in three steps, across four themes: Education, History, Kids, and Storytelling. Script. Pick a topic or write your own; set format, length (1–5 min), and animation style. Style. Choose from 8 presets, from Stickman Cartoon to Studio 3D. Voice. Pick a narrator; output is a finished episode with script, voiceover and animation. Channels. Style and voice are saved in your channel, so new episodes look and sound the same. To get started: open Faceless Studio and create a channel.

news.title: Higgsfield for Enterprise
news.body: Higgsfield for Enterprise gives large teams secure, dedicated access to Seedance models. Dedicated US deployment. Enterprise access to Seedance models on dedicated US GPU infrastructure, with dedicated capacity and concurrency. Security and access. SOC 2 and SSO. Hands-on support. A dedicated Account Manager and a Forward Deployed Creative to onboard marketing teams into AI-native production. Team controls. Unlimited seats and per-team credit allocation for control over each project's unit economics. Learn more: higgsfield.ai/enterprise

news.title: Seedance 2.5 in 1080p. Early access
news.body: Seedance 2.5 now generates in 1080p on Higgsfield, in early access. It's included with Plus plans and above. Limited time offers: Free trial for new users. Five 1080p generations, up to 20 seconds each, over 24 hours. No charge, card verification only. Bonus Seconds for subscribers. Generate Seedance 2.5 at 1080p at a reduced credit cost. Each pack is a pool of seconds billed by clip length, so a 10-second video spends 10 seconds from the pool, leaving credits untouched. Valid 30 days.

news.title: Create in Public. Now live for the Higgsfield Film Festival
news.body: Create in Public is a way for the community to back each other, and for the Higgsfield team to back creators with grants. You publish an unfinished version of your project to a public page, where people can watch it, like it, and follow its progress. Publishing gets you: Shortlist of up to top 50 projects. Community support gives a project a chance to stand out before judging begins. Higgsfield Picks. Separate from the community top 50; the team watches published projects and can select strong work at any point in August, regardless of rating or likes. Credit Grants. Published projects are candidates for Higgsfield grants, up to 100k credits per project. To get started: head to the Create in Public page and hit Create a public project.

news.title: Nano Banana Pro. Fixed.
news.body: Nano Banana Pro had a high failure rate from a temporary Google infrastructure issue. Resolved on the provider's side.

news.title: Cinema Studio 4.0
news.body: Cinema Studio 4.0 is live. Improved duration, references, camera, color, and character performance. 30-second generations. Up from before, enough for a full character arc. Up to 50 references per generation to lock a face, product, or style. Camera. 30+ movement presets, 4 camera types, and a rebuilt 5-lens system. Colour Palette. 50+ presets for tonal direction without manual grading. Emotion Wheel. Direct a character's performance with 8+ emotions. Era selector. Pick a decade; grain, color, and lens style adjust to match. Tempo control over cut speed and frequency. Forward / Backward Extend. Continue or lead into an existing clip. To get started: open Cinema Studio and start a new project.

news.title: Layers. Separate any image into its individual elements
news.body: Layers turns any flat image into separate, editable elements you can adjust and rebuild individually. Layer Decomposition. Splits a flat image into independently editable elements. Edit Text. Finds text in an image and regenerates it with your replacements. Remove Background. Removes the background; the result drops straight into your project for further editing. To get started: go to Layers and upload a new image, or select an existing asset and choose Edit in the menu on the right.

news.title: Spanish language support
news.body: Higgsfield is now available in Spanish. Users can switch the site to Spanish directly, with no third-party translation needed. Signed-in users. The switch is available in the profile menu when hovering over the profile icon, in Personal Profile, and in Supercomputer. Signed-out users. The language switch is in the footer, at the bottom of the page.

news.title: Higgsfield Global Film Festival. Submissions open
news.body: The Global Film Festival is now live and accepting entries. Submissions close September 3. Where to begin. Two ways: click Create festival project on the festival page, or open the Film Festival Contest section in Cinema Studio and create your folder there. Both open a dedicated Cinema Studio project. Build and submit in one place. Generate your shots in that project, then submit the finished film with all its assets from there. No paid plan required. Any registered Higgsfield user can enter. To start: open the Festival page or head to Cinema Studio.

news.title: Audio. Redesigned, with a new model
news.body: Audio has been redesigned. A new model, Qwen, has been added, along with advanced settings for audio models: control over emotion, format, pitch, and more. Text to Speech. Generate speech from text using a preset voice, or upload or record your own. Voice Change. Swap the voice in an uploaded video while keeping the original delivery. Translate. Translate and lip-sync a video into another language, from a library of 18 languages. To get started: open Audio and pick Text to Speech, Voice Change, or Translate.

news.title: Higgsfield Academy. New video-lesson format
news.body: Academy has been redesigned. The old courses are retired and replaced by interactive video lessons. Completion no longer comes with a certificate. Courses play as video. Each course runs like a YouTube guide, split into short sections so you can move at your own pace. In-video prompts. Prompts pop up in the corner during the video; copy one on the spot or find it later in the Keypoints panel. Overview under the player. A short course summary and a per-lesson breakdown of what each lesson covers sit below the video. To get started: open Academy and pick a course.

news.title: Viral Presets. 13 new styles
news.body: Thirteen new presets are live in the Viral Presets section, built around current short-form trends. New additions include Agamemnon, Bullet Time, Fallen Angel, Dolphin Ride, and Monet Muse. To get started: open Viral Presets → pick a preset → upload an image → get a video in that style.

news.title: Seedance 2.5
news.body: Seedance 2.5 from ByteDance is available on Higgsfield, the latest version in the Seedance video family. Clips up to 30 seconds, with ambience, foley, and score generated in the same pass as the picture. Region-level edits. An object or a face can be fixed in one spot without re-rendering the whole clip; a single shot in a sequence can be re-rolled separately. Up to 50 references per generation to lock characters, products, and style. Resolution. The model generates at 480p and 720p, with upscaling up to 4K. To get started: Video → model selector → Seedance 2.5. Availability: mid and upper plans include a 33-day unlimited window on Seedance 2.5, with clip-length limits varying by plan.

news.title: Higgsfield Global Film Festival
news.body: A short-film contest with a $1,000,000 prize pool. Films must be at least 3 minutes long and generated entirely on Higgsfield within the generation window. Eligibility. Open worldwide, 18+. Solo or teams of up to 4. Prizes. 1st $500,000, 2nd $200,000, 3rd $100,000, Audience Choice $100,000, and 10 honorable mentions of $10,000 each. Dates. Opens August 10, submissions close September 3, winners announced the first week of October. To get started: open the Higgsfield Global Film Festival contest page.

news.title: All Unlimited. Every top model, unlimited
news.body: Get Unlimited access to all our top Image, Video, and Audio models at once, including Nano Banana Pro, Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni Flash, GPT Image, and more. One pass to everything. Image, video, and audio top models covered by a single Unlimited offer. Three ways in. A 1-day free trial for new users, 7 days included on premium monthly plans, or a bundle for existing plans. To get started: start the 1-day free trial, pick an eligible plan on Pricing, or buy a bundle from the Unlimited models button in your profile menu. Availability: limits vary by plan, see the Pricing page. Unlimited runs 1 image, video, or audio at a time, on a shared concurrency across models.

news.title: Site not loading. Fixed.
news.body: Some users couldn't load the site, mainly in Chrome, while mobile and Safari worked. Fixed on the provider's side, everything is running normally again.

news.title: Free Mode in Supercomputer. Text generation at zero credits
news.body: Supercomputer now has a Free Mode: a free LLM for text generation, with no credits deducted. Fully free text. All text generations on the Free model cost nothing, and there are no usage limits for now. Image and video generation still spend credits as usual. New mode structure. Auto and Efficient are gone: Free (free model), Smart (top models for complex reasoning), and Manual (pick your own model: GLM, DeepSeek, Seed, Opus, etc.). Effort control in Manual. Choose Low/Medium/High/Extra to set how long the model "thinks": lower effort is faster, higher effort means deeper reasoning and better results. To get started: pick Free, Smart, or Manual in the Supercomputer mode selector.

news.title: Higgsfield Filmmaker Grant. 100,000 credits for the boldest creators
news.body: The Filmmaker Grant is a 2-week training program for the most talented creators, hand-picked by the Higgsfield creative team. What selected creators get. 100,000 credits: the full grant lands on the account on selection day, no daily limits, plus a 2-week program with live sessions from the creative team and a private Discord with shot breakdowns and direct feedback. Who can apply. 18+, worldwide, any creative background. Required: a certificate for The AI Filmmaking Pipeline course in Higgsfield Academy. How selection works. Every application is reviewed manually by the creative team, there's no single winner. Selected creators are contacted directly. To get started: complete The AI Filmmaking Pipeline in Academy and claim your certificate → prepare a showreel of your strongest work (any skill, any tools, with or without AI) → post it on Instagram, X, LinkedIn, or Reddit with the caption "Higgsfield Filmmaker Grant: Why I Want It" → submit the post link through the application form.

news.title: Higgsfield Academy. Learn by generating
news.body: Higgsfield Academy is a new learning hub on the platform: practical workflows from working AI filmmakers, finish a course, take a real brief, join the crew. Built for total beginners and future power users alike. Watch & Learn. The latest YouTube how-to guides from our creative team: tips and workflows for making ultra-realistic content with our newest releases. Interactive courses. From tool onboarding to making your own film. Interactive and teacher-free: many lessons embed the actual product plus quizzes, and each course ends with a final exam. Two Cinema Studio courses are live: Getting Started with Cinema Studio (Beginner, 12 lessons, 26 min, 8 Free generations) and The AI Filmmaking Pipeline (Medium, 22 lessons, 58 min, 50+ Free generations). Free to learn. All you need is a Higgsfield account, free generations are built into every course, so your own credits aren't spent. Certificates. The AI Filmmaking Pipeline course grants a certificate with a unique credential ID, postable straight to LinkedIn. Filmmaker Grant, right on the page. The certificate for The AI Filmmaking Pipeline is the ticket in: learn the craft → cut your showreel → post it and tell us why it should b

news.title: Referral program. Invite friends, get Unlimited Seedance 2.0
news.body: Update: the referral program ended on July 16, 2026. Invite friends and earn up to 7 days of Unlimited Seedance 2.0 (720p, 8 sec), while your friends get up to 60% off their plan purchase. How it works. Generate your unique referral link, a 24-hour window starts. If a friend follows it, purchases a Plus/Pro monthly plan or higher, and makes 1 credit-paid generation within that window, you get the reward. More friends, more days. 1 friend → 3 days, 2 friends → 5 days, 3 friends → 7 days (the maximum). After 24 hours. The link can't be recreated, but the block with invited friends stays visible; if all friends complete the steps, a modal confirms your reward. To get started: click on the «Refer a friend» button in your profile menu, generate your link, and share it. Availability: on Pro/Plus plans and above. Not available on Starter/Basic and Team plans.

news.title: Adobe After Effects in Supercomputer and MCP. Describe it, watch it build
news.body: The Adobe After Effects plugin now works in Supercomputer and Claude via MCP: the agent works directly with compositions, layers, keyframes, effects, and scripts. Effects and animations from a description, built right in your composition. Recreate from references. Design from an image reference, animation from a video reference. Expressions on demand. Describe the behavior and get the expression written for you. Higgsfield generations imported straight into the composition. To get started: for MCP, install the Adobe plugin and connect it in Claude's connectors via bridge.higgsfield.ai/mcp. For Supercomputer, just install the plugin and it's detected automatically.

news.title: Activity Rewards. Get rewarded for what you already do
news.body: A new rewards system gives you bonuses for completing tasks and staying active on the platform: free gens, credit cashback, and Unlimited days. Tasks in your notifications. Find them left of your profile icon, complete them, and claim the reward. Real rewards. Spend 1,000 credits → free gens on Nano Banana Pro 2K. Generate 10+ minutes on Seedance 2.0 → 1 day of Unlimited Seedance 2.0 Fast 720p. Generate 15 days in a row → 5 days of Unlimited NBP 2K. Grand prize. Complete every task on time and monthly Pro and higher plans get 7 days of Unlimited Nano Banana Pro 2K right after renewal; annual plans get the same after 2 full months without cancelling. To get started: open your notifications and check your active tasks. Availability: on Pro/Plus plans and above. Claim rewards in your notifications before your next renewal, unclaimed rewards expire.

news.title: Extra storage in Supercomputer. Expand past 20GB
news.body: You can now expand your Supercomputer storage beyond the base 20GB, paid monthly with credits: 1GB costs 2.5 credits, with the first charge at your next billing cycle. Pro/Plus: up to +30GB extra, 50GB total. Max/Ultra: an adjustable slider up to +980GB extra (1TB total), any value from +10GB and up. Manage anytime. Downsize or cancel from Manage Storage, changes take effect at the next billing cycle. To get started: hit Expand your storage in Manage Storage, or when you reach the 20GB limit.

news.title: Moodboards in Soul 2.0. Fixed.
news.body: Curated moodboards in Soul 2.0 weren't loading. Resolved, a quick refresh brings moodboards back to normal.

news.title: GPT‑5.6 and Grok 4.5 in Supercomputer
news.body: Two new models in the Supercomputer selector. GPT‑5.6. OpenAI's most powerful model to date: breaks complex pipelines into subtasks, holds more steps in mind at once, and stays on track through long multi-stage runs. Pick it for the most demanding work where depth matters more than speed. Grok 4.5. xAI's new model with a strong engineering base: noticeably faster, well balanced between speed and quality, and cheaper at comparable quality on most technical tasks, a solid default for everyday pipelines. To get started: pick GPT‑5.6 or Grok 4.5 in the Supercomputer model selector.

news.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro. Your idea, rendered exactly
news.body: Seedream 5.0 Pro from ByteDance is built to translate the creator's intent into the final visual with precision: complex infographics, surgical edits, and photoreal textures. Infographics in one pass. Charts, diagrams, and realistic photos in a single frame, with logical structure and no data loss. Point-level editing. It understands what sits where in the frame: point selection, color and material swaps without rebuilding the scene. Group shots from references. Combines several reference photos of people into one shot with unified lighting and texture. Real light physics. Glass reflections, water splashes, and motion-blur panning. Native text in 10+ languages. Including Arabic (right-to-left), Russian, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish, with accurate local typography. To get started: Image → model selector → Seedream 5.0 Pro. Also available through Supercomputer, MCP, and CLI.

news.title: Site downtime. Fixed.
news.body: The site was down from 13:38 to 13:52 UTC. Resolved, everything is running normally again.

news.title: Higgsfield Apps. Build generative apps, not just sites
news.body: Supercomputer now builds full generative apps that create images, video, and 3D through Higgsfield models: the agent wires the models in itself, no API keys or code. Describe it, get it. The agent handles design, code, database, sign-in, and model integration, from a landing page or portfolio to a full web app with logic and auth (AI photobooth, anime filter, generative tools). Three base templates: Studio, Stepper, and Simple App. Edit in the same chat. Say "make it dark" or "add a gallery" and the agent updates the app with a fresh preview in minutes. Users pay for their own generations. People sign in with their Higgsfield account and generate on their own credits, so a thousand users cost the creator nothing. Builds spend your regular credits, up to 20 apps a day. Publish and remix. One-click SEO and security checks at publish, auto-generated cover, icon, and description (editable), like/dislike, reports, and Credit Spend display. The new My Apps section shows what's published, with hover editing. To get started: Apps now live in the Products section in Supercomputer. Describe your app in chat and the agent does the rest. Also available through MCP, so you can build straig

news.title: Storage Management in Supercomputer. See it, clear it
news.body: You can now see your Supercomputer storage and clear the cache right from the interface, and the default storage quota went up from 5GB to 20GB for all users. Storage at a glance. See how much space is used. Cache cleared in a couple of clicks. To get started: open Manage Account within the Supercomputer page → Usage → scroll to the bottom.

news.title: Unlimited Models Marketplace. Now on Team and Scale
news.body: The Unlimited Models Marketplace is live for Team and Scale plans, at the same prices and model selection as individual plans. Per-seat purchase. Bundles are bought per seat, a single bundle can't be shared among multiple team members. Assign after purchase. The owner sets seat count at checkout, then assigns bundles right away or later from Manage Account → Subscription. Assign once. A bundle can only be assigned one time and can't be reassigned to someone else. Owner and admin can assign. Purchasing is owner-only; admins can assign if the owner grants that permission. To get started: Unlimited models button in the profile menu, or Manage Account → Subscription; same entry points as on individual plans. Availability: the bundle term starts at purchase, not at assignment, so unassigned time is lost if not assigned before it expires.

news.title: Higgsfield Explainer. Now its own app
news.body: Explainer is no longer just a Supercomputer/MCP skill, it's a standalone tool on the platform, with a full visual interface. Full creative control. Set style, character, voice, and motion yourself, no agent needed. Preset library built in. Pick a visual style right in the interface. Everything in one screen. Topic, narrator voice, format, and length, then generate in one click. To get started: open Higgsfield Explainer → pick a preset → describe your topic (optionally add a photo or link) → set aspect ratio, duration, and voice → Generate. Availability: up to 10 minutes, 16:9 or 9:16.

news.title: Higgsfield Video Explainer. Narrative video, one voice, any style
news.body: A new skill in Supercomputer and MCP for narrative video: one voiceover runs over several stylized 10-second blocks, held together in a single visual style; animated only, no photorealism (2D, ink sketch, painterly textures, and more). Built for explainers and storytelling in any genre or tone. Faceless-friendly. Visual and voiceover carry the video, no host required. To get started: ask Supercomputer for a narrative video, it picks up the skill automatically. Describe your topic or story, choose style, language, format, and length. Availability: up to 10 minutes, 16:9 or 9:16.

news.title: Claude Fable 5 is back
news.body: Anthropic reopened access to Claude Fable 5! It's back in Supercomputer and MCP, and Supercomputer Games are powered by Fable 5 once again. Plans and finishes on its own. Breaks a task into steps and carries it through without hand-holding. Full content pipelines in Supercomputer, from idea to finished assets in one pass. On-brand motion. Motion design and ad videos that hold a consistent style across frames. Better games. Higher-quality, more thought-out builds in Supercomputer Games.

news.title: Claude Sonnet 5. Anthropic's most agentic Sonnet yet
news.body: Claude Sonnet 5 is live in Higgsfield MCP and Supercomputer: a new level of autonomy that used to require heavier, pricier models. Plans and executes on its own. Runs full marketing-asset pipelines through Higgsfield MCP without step-by-step guidance. Faster agent pipelines. Speeds up and streamlines agentic workflows inside Supercomputer. Sharper output. Better context handling for more precise ideas and structured content. Opus-level results, lower cost. Handles tasks that used to need Opus, at a fraction of the price. To get started: pick Claude Sonnet 5 in the model selector in Supercomputer or MCP.

news.title: Shorts Studio. Any video, any style, one click
news.body: Shorts Studio restyles your own footage into a completely new look, powered by Gemini Omni Flash. Upload a clip, pick a style, and get a finished short on the other end. 44 ready-made presets, or build your own from a photo/video moodboard and Shorts Studio picks up the style. Motion stays yours. Original pacing and performance carry over, only the look changes. To get started: Video → Shorts Studio → upload a reference video → pick a preset → Generate. Availability: Input up to 2 minutes, output up to 10 seconds, 9:16 or 16:9.

news.title: Nano Banana 2 Lite. Draft at full speed, spend less doing it
news.body: Nano Banana 2 Lite is Google's fast, low-cost image model at 1K, made for rapid iterations, bulk content, and social previews before you commit to a hi-res final. Text rendering and general quality stay on par with Nano Banana 2. Up to 14 reference images. Pull a person, a scene, and a product into one composition. Auto aspect ratio. It takes framing from your reference, or pick from the full ratio set. To get started: Image → model selector → Nano Banana 2 Lite. Availability: 1K only. Use Nano Banana 2 when you need 2K or 4K.

news.title: Gemini Omni Flash. One prompt in, a whole scene out
news.body: Gemini Omni Flash from Google DeepMind reads text, images, and video together and composes them into one coherent shot, so you build a scene from references instead of describing it from scratch. Consistent characters. Face, outfit, and voice hold across every edit, so you can revise a shot without recasting it. Real-world physics. Gravity, weight, and collisions behave correctly, so motion looks filmed, not simulated. Edit by talking. Change one element of an existing clip in plain language instead of regenerating the whole scene. To get started: Video → model selector → Gemini Omni. Add a prompt, or bring an image, start and end frame, or a clip to edit. Availability: Preview (beta). 720p, clips of 4, 6, 8, or 10 seconds, 16:9 or 9:16, with native audio.

news.title: App Builder. Describe a site, get a live URL
news.body: App Builder in Supercomputer turns a prompt into a deployed website, so you go from idea to a shareable link without touching a codebase. Full stack, not a mockup. Front end, back end, database, auth, file storage, and API integrations. Assets generated in place. Images and video are created with Higgsfield inside the site, no stock or placeholders. Yours to iterate. Edit meta tags and link previews, store secret keys, and remix other published sites. To get started: Supercomputer → describe the site, for example "build a landing page for a fitness studio." You get a live link at a higgsfield.app URL. Availability: on all paid plans. Each build and deploy uses credits to generate assets, so heavier sites use more.

news.title: Unlimited Models Marketplace. Pay once, generate without limits
news.body: The Unlimited Models Marketplace lets you buy unlimited access to a top model for a fixed window instead of spending credits per generation, so a heavy production day costs the same as a quiet one. Pick your model. Nano Banana Pro, Seedance 2.0, Enhanced Seedance 2.0 Fast & Mini, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0, or All Models. Pick your window. 1, 7, or 14 days, so you can match a launch or a client sprint. Set your quality tier. Where a model offers tiers, the top tier includes every lower resolution. To get started: open the Unlimited models button in your profile menu, or Manage Account → Subscription → Get Unlimited. A banner and a modal on the credits page also link to it. Availability: on Pro and Plus plans and above. Generations through MCP, CLI, Canvas, and Supercomputer still use credits. See the Pricing page for your options.

news.title: Seed Audio 1.0. Score a whole scene in one pass
news.body: Seed Audio 1.0 from ByteDance generates speech, sound effects, and music together from a single prompt, so a clip gets voice, ambience, and a soundtrack in one step instead of three tools and a manual mix. Multi-speaker with continuity. Several voices hold across the scene, with emotion and accent control. Ambience, music, and Foley. Rain, traffic, room tone, a musical bed, footsteps, and textures. Context-aware. Give it text, an image, or an audio reference to guide the result. To get started: Audio → model selector → Seed Audio. Describe the scene, including how long each element should run. Availability: outputs in WAV, MP3, PCM, or OGG. Voice cloning supports up to 3 audio references. Length is set through your prompt, not a duration field.

news.title: Higgsfield Audio in MCP. Voice your video without leaving Claude
news.body: Higgsfield Audio is now in MCP: generate a voiceover, create a custom voice, change a voice, and translate, right from the chat. To get started: connect Higgsfield MCP in Claude, then ask for a voiceover, voice change, or translation.

news.title: Soul Cinema generation failures. Fixed.
news.body: Soul Cinema generations were failing. Resolved, generations run normally again, and credits for failed generations are refunded automatically.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 Mini. Seedance speed, roughly doubled
news.body: Seedance 2.0 Mini is a lighter model in the Seedance 2.0 family, exclusive to Higgsfield with BytePlus, about twice as fast as Enhanced Seedance 2.0 Fast at comparable quality. Built for short-form, ad cutdowns, and quick iterations. To get started: Video → model selector → Seedance 2.0 Mini. It's also part of the Seedance 2.0 Unlimited Family alongside Enhanced Seedance 2.0 Fast. Availability: 480p and 720p, clips of 4 to 15 seconds, from text, image, video, or audio references.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 in 4K. Hero shots that hold up on big screens
news.body: Seedance 2.0 now generates video in 4K, so hero shots hold up on large screens without a separate upscale. To get started: Video → Seedance 2.0 → set resolution to 4K.

news.title: High Bitrate in Seedance. Higher quality, same credits
news.body: A new Standard or High bitrate choice: High gives higher video quality at the same credit cost, with a larger final file. To get started: in Seedance, set bitrate to High before generating.

news.title: AI Employees 2.0. Your AI Employees now remember
news.body: AI Employees 2.0 turns Supercomputer's agents into teammates that carry context, so "do it like last time" actually works. Persistent memory. Each Employee remembers your preferences across sessions. Connectors. Slack, Drive, Notion, Gmail, Figma, and 30 or more integrations, so an Employee can read your docs and deliver to the right folder or channel. Marketplace and sharing. Publish an Employee, install others in one click, or import skills and memory from Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT. To get started: in Supercomputer, open an Employee card to edit its instructions, files, and memory, or create your own. Image, Video, and Text Generator are now Skills, called with /.

news.title: Seedance Unlimited. Generate without spending credits
news.body: Generate Seedance without spending credits within the Unlimited tier at 480p and 720p. Look for the Seedance model with the Unlimited badge in the selector. To get started: on an eligible plan, select the Seedance model marked Unlimited. Older plans may see an add-on offer for 1, 7, or 14 days.

news.title: Supercomputer onboarding. Start with a guided path
news.body: New users get a welcome screen with three starting points, UGC video, Landing page, or Full marketing campaign, and Supercomputer sets up the right AI Employees and skills automatically. To get started: open Supercomputer for the first time and pick a use case, or skip to start from scratch.

news.title: Kling 3.0 Turbo. Test ten ideas in the time one used to take
news.body: Kling 3.0 Turbo runs the same cinematic Kling model at much higher speed, so you lock the shot on fast drafts and render the final on standard Kling 3.0. To get started: Video → model selector → Kling 3.0 Turbo. Supports text-to-video and image-to-video. Availability: on the web, in Supercomputer, MCP, and CLI.

news.title: ByteDance Upscale. Take any clip to 4K
news.body: ByteDance Upscale is a new engine in the Upscale selector that raises video to 4K with frame interpolation up to 60fps in one pass, tuned for both AI-generated and real footage. Scene-aware presets. Match the preset to your footage, from AI generations to short series, UGC, or old-film restoration. Simple by tier. Pick 2K or 4K and go, without model-by-model tuning. To get started: Video → Upscale → choose the ByteDance engine, then set resolution and preset. For fine restoration, face enhancement, or slow-mo, use the Topaz engine instead.

news.title: Higgsfield in Photoshop. Run Higgsfield without leaving Photoshop
news.body: Generate AI Image, Realtime AI, Mockup Studio, Layer Decompose, Angles, Shots, Character Swap, Remove Background, Face Swap, Upscale, Skin Enhancer, and AI Stylist, plus Cinema Studio and Marketing Studio. To get started: download the installer from higgsfield.ai/plugins/photoshop, then open Window, Extensions, Higgsfield. Works on Photoshop 2024 and above, and credits come from your plan balance.

news.title: View member assets (Enterprise). See your team's work in one place
news.body: Enterprise owners and admins can see members' generations across the organization, grouped by date with filtering by member. To get started: in admin permissions → turn on View member assets, then open the Member assets section.

news.title: Higgsfield Gaming. Build a playable game from a prompt
news.body: Higgsfield Gaming turns a description into a browser-playable game, with art, sound, music, characters, and multiplayer generated for you. Two ways to build. In Supercomputer, or through MCP in Claude with the Game Studio skill. Publish and remix. Ship to the Higgsfield Games marketplace, where others can play and remix your game. To get started: in Supercomputer, pick a genre and style and describe the game. Or add the Higgsfield connector and gaming skill in Claude. Availability: games generate every asset with Higgsfield, so they use significantly more credits than a single generation. A cost estimate is shown before you build.

news.title: New reasoning models in Supercomputer. More planning power
news.body: New reasoning models in the Supercomputer selector for planning and longer builds. To get started: pick a model in the selector. Availability depends on your plan and selected mode.

news.title: New tools in Higgsfield MCP. Five more tools in Claude
news.body: Kling Motion Control, Click-to-Ad, Remove Background, Upscale to 4K, and Expand to 16:9 or 9:16, all callable from Claude. To get started: update your Higgsfield MCP connection in Claude and call the tool by name.

news.title: Reference image upload in MCP. Improved.
news.body: Uploading reference images through Higgsfield MCP in Claude now works via an in-chat widget: upload, wait for Ready, and click Continue, for image-to-image, image-to-video, and character reference.

news.title: Higgsfield in DaVinci Resolve. Generate and edit without exporting
news.body: Video and Image Generation, Edit Video and Draw to Video from a prompt, Reframe, Remove BG, Upscale, Color Match to build a LUT, and Import straight to your Media Pool or Timeline. To get started: install the plugin from higgsfield.ai, load a clip or reference, submit, then download or import the result.

news.title: Cinema Studio. Its own workspace, at last
news.body: Cinema Studio has a dedicated space with its own navigation, unified with Collab, so a whole production lives in one place instead of scattered generations. Projects and subfolders. Organize scenes and assets the way you'd organize a shoot. Characters and locations with @. Pull your elements into a Describe your scene prompt bar. Sections at a glance. Home, My Generations, My Elements, My Favorites, and Community Feed. To get started: open Cinema Studio → create or open a project → describe your scene.

news.title: Sub-workspaces for Enterprise. Split credits across teams
news.body: Enterprise owners can create sub-workspaces inside their main workspace and distribute credits from the shared pool, each with its own owner, allocation period, and limits. To get started: Manage Account → Sub-workspaces → Add → set the name, credits, allocation period, and owner.

news.title: Higgsfield in Minecraft. Generate inside the game
news.body: Generate images, video, and full builds inside Minecraft. Prompt to Build materializes structures block by block, with in-game Camera, Photo Slide, Video Projector, and Generation Archive. To get started: install the mod → launch Minecraft → type /higgsfield auth in chat, then confirm in the browser.

news.title: Higgsfield in Figma and FigJam. Generate on the canvas
news.body: Image generation across models, Vector Generation (SVG), Mockup Studio, Remove Background, Color Grading, Expand, Relight, Angles, and Face Swap. FigJam adds Canvas Nodes with chain workflows. To get started: in Figma or FigJam → open Plugins, Find more plugins → search Higgsfield AI. Generate, then drag and drop or Insert.

news.title: Grok Video 1.5. Bring a still to life
news.body: Grok Video 1.5 from xAI animates a still image while keeping the source composition and style, using your image as the first frame, and it also works from text alone. To get started: Video → model selector → Grok Video. Add a prompt, and optionally one start image. Availability: 1 to 15 seconds, 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1.

news.title: AI Employees. A team of agents inside Supercomputer
news.body: AI Employees are ready-made agents you call with @, and they orchestrate the right skills for you, so you brief a task instead of wiring up tools. Ready-made roles. Video Generator, Image Generator, Cinematic Director, UGC Creator, and more. Marketplace. Browse Employees, Skills, and Connectors, and install with one click. My Office. One place for everything you've installed and created. To get started: open Supercomputer → browse the Marketplace → call an Employee with @. Skills didn't go away, they live in the Marketplace and run with / or automatically.

news.title: Recraft v4.1. Design-grade images, vectors included
news.body: Recraft v4.1 is built for professional design work, with strong typography, clean lines, and brand visuals, and it can output editable vector SVG straight from a prompt. Four modes. Standard for general work, Vector for logos and icons, Utility for product shots, Utility Vector for brand assets. Native vector. Vector modes scale without quality loss, ideal for logos and icons. Brand controls. A palette of up to 10 colors, a background color, and 1K or 2K output. To get started: Image → model selector → Recraft → choose a mode.

news.title: Recraft V4 Styles
news.body: Recraft V4 Styles is live on Higgsfield, holding a single reference style across every generation. Aimed at brand work, where the output has to look like the last one.

news.title: FLUX.3 Video Upscale
news.body: FLUX.3 Video Upscale is on Higgsfield, upscaling natively rather than frame by frame so motion stays natural at higher resolutions. Output at 2K and 4K, with Precise and Creative modes, cleaner textures and finer detail.

news.title: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash on Higgsfield
news.body: Higgsfield has Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with a set of controls for video generation: first and last frames with everything generated in between, scene extension to 40 seconds, and cheap 360p tests that upscale to 1080p or 4K.

news.title: Higgsfield Raises $400M at a $5.4B Valuation
news.body: Higgsfield raised a $400 million Series B led by DST Global, with Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Valor Capital, and Tribe Capital participating, quadrupling its valuation in eight months from $1.3 billion to $5.4 billion. The company reports $700 million in annualised revenue, 30 million users across 200 countries, and work with 390 Fortune 500 companies. The money goes to hiring, product, and the compute that video generation demands.

news.title: Introducing Higgsfield Layers
news.body: Higgsfield Layers is an image editor with layer decomposition, flawless text rendering, and native 4K. Upload or generate any image, split it into layers and edit each one separately, and regenerate any text or object without changing the rest of the image.

news.title: Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield
news.body: Seedance 2.5 is now live on Higgsfield: next-level skin shading and lighting, accurate lip-sync and facial expressions, and video-to-video. Characters, outfits, light, and location carry through the whole 30-second sequence.

news.title: After Effects Plugin Upgraded (Fable 5)
news.body: Higgsfield's MCP/Plugin for After Effects got a major upgrade, powered by Claude Fable 5. Build your own AE plugins, drop in a reference and have it decomposed into editable vector layers you can animate, get an AI assistant that answers or does the work for you, and localize a project seamlessly.

news.title: Free Mode in Higgsfield Supercomputer
news.body: Free Mode is live in Higgsfield Supercomputer: the LLM inside is now free to use for brainstorming, prompt writing, scripting, research, and project planning. Credits kick in only when you generate. A Supercomputer-level LLM, yours to use.

news.title: Meet Higgsfield Academy
news.body: Higgsfield is training the next generation of AI filmmakers. The directors behind Hell Grind, its 95-minute feature screened in Cannes, are opening their playbook as fully interactive courses. Learn to make movies, not just generations, with free generation credits included and a 100,000-credit Filmmaker Grant for standout graduates.

news.title: Higgsfield Apps
news.body: Higgsfield launched Higgsfield Apps — its biggest release yet. Generate apps with any Higgsfield image or video model built in, with Fable 5 engineering every app like a top engineer. Build aesthetic websites of any complexity and ship browser extensions, plugins, and desktop and mobile apps, then deploy when done. Available on Supercomputer and on Claude via Higgsfield MCP.

news.title: Higgsfield Explainer
news.body: Higgsfield introduced Explainer, powered by Claude Fable 5 and Gemini Omni Flash — faceless documentaries at scale. It auto-researches your topic, narrates in any language, and renders up to 10 minutes in one run. Available on Higgsfield, MCP, and Supercomputer.

news.title: Higgsfield MCP Now Free
news.body: Higgsfield MCP is now free — every new user gets 100 free credits to generate content with Fable 5 driving Higgsfield MCP on Claude. Grab the free trial plan for full MCP access for 3 days. Limited offer.

news.title: Gemini Omni Flash on Higgsfield
news.body: Gemini Omni Flash is live on Higgsfield — infinite world knowledge, top-tier editing, real motion design, and text that holds across every frame. You can also run it on Claude via the Higgsfield MCP.

news.title: Nano Banana 2 Lite on Higgsfield
news.body: Nano Banana 2 Lite is live on Higgsfield — as good as Nano Banana 2 but far faster and cheaper: under 4 seconds per image at $0.034 per 1K images. The most efficient image model for scaling agentic pipelines through the Higgsfield MCP.

news.title: Sonnet 5 on Higgsfield
news.body: Claude Sonnet 5 is live on Higgsfield — it plans and runs marketing asset pipelines on its own via the Higgsfield MCP, at a level that used to need bigger, costlier models, and makes agentic pipelines more efficient on Higgsfield Supercomputer.

news.title: Seed Audio 1.0
news.body: Seed Audio 1.0 is live on Higgsfield — the best audio model for anything you make. Change a voice, narrate from text, or dub a video into 18 languages. Also available on Claude via the Higgsfield MCP.

news.title: Higgsfield Supercomputer 2.0
news.body: Introducing Higgsfield Supercomputer 2.0 — its first autonomous AI agent, accelerated by NVIDIA technology, to run your marketing end to end with enterprise-level trust, safety, and permissioning.

news.title: Audio Generation in Claude via Higgsfield MCP
news.body: Claude can now generate audio via the Higgsfield MCP — voiceovers, voice cloning, and dubbing in 50+ languages, powered by Seed Audio 1.0 and ElevenLabs v3, all inside Claude.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 in Native 4K
news.body: Seedance 2.0 in native 4K on Higgsfield — skin texture, glass rendering, directional lighting, and real micro-expressions. The kind of frame professional filmmakers would cut into a production.

news.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 on Higgsfield
news.body: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 is now on Higgsfield — best-in-class realism, stronger physics, and faster generations, top-tier on Arena at 1467 Elo. Higgsfield is now an official partner with the xAI team.

news.title: Higgsfield Mod for Minecraft
news.body: Higgsfield Mod for Minecraft is live — prompt buildings, cities, create paintings with text-to-image, restyle views with image-to-image, and animate photos with image-to-video.

news.title: Figma Plugin Live
news.body: Higgsfield plugin for Figma is live — generate images with every model, create SVG vectors, build mockups, remove backgrounds, and animate hero creatives.

news.title: MCP Claude Motion
news.body: Claude can now build motion web apps with Higgsfield MCP — drop your brand kit, generate motion videos, and build a scroll-driven website.

news.title: Claude Analyze Video
news.body: Claude can now analyze and reimagine any video with Higgsfield MCP — paste a video reference, analyze structure and pacing, and generate assets in the same chat.

news.title: Reframe
news.body: Higgsfield Reframe lets Claude change aspect ratios without cropping — give it a reference image and the background holds up in any format.

news.title: Higgsfield for Adobe Is Live
news.body: Higgsfield plugins for Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects are now live. Generate images, videos, and transitions directly in your timeline. Reframe aspect ratios without cropping, remove backgrounds from footage, draw on a clip to edit, and upscale to 4K on export.

news.title: Agents Can Now Post to X, Instagram, Threads, and LinkedIn
news.body: Higgsfield Supercomputer's new social connectors let your agents pull posts, publish them, and run a self-learning marketing loop end to end — across X, Instagram, Threads, and LinkedIn.

news.title: Viral Presets Pack 2
news.body: Viral Presets Pack 2 is live — trends going viral now with weeks of runway left. KUNG FU HIT, FOOTBALL INVADER, ZOMBIE DANCE, GOLF MAJOR, ANDROID ASSEMBLE, STORM GIANT, DRIFT RACING, FREE FALL, and more. Available on Higgsfield and in Claude via the Higgsfield MCP.

news.title: Personal Clipper via Higgsfield MCP
news.body: Personal Clipper is now available in Claude via the Higgsfield MCP. Drop a video link, ask Higgsfield MCP to cut it into X clips based on the most viral moments, choose aspect ratio and subtitle font, and get clips ready to post across every social platform.

news.title: Higgsfield MCP for Cursor
news.body: Higgsfield MCP now connects to Cursor. Generate beautiful assets for your website — page banners, product photos, demo and walkthrough videos, data visualizations, and motion design. Build websites in Cursor, generate marketing assets in Higgsfield, auto-publish.

news.title: Higgsfield Lands on Manus
news.body:
You can now use Higgsfield on Manus. We're giving professional creators more ways to create, refine, and ship visual work inside Manus.
• Use your preferred models and controls
• Turn generated visuals into websites, launch assets, and motion concepts
• Move outputs into Manus workflows for review, iteration, and handoff
Let agents handle the heavy lifting.

news.title: Introducing Higgsfield Supercomputer
news.body:
The first ever cloud-native, self-learning AI agent for end-to-end task execution. 40+ built-in tools. Three layers of memory. Access via browser or Telegram. Powered by enhanced Hermes Agent.

How it works:
1. Access via browser or Telegram — no local setup
2. Describe your task
3. Orchestrates LLMs and image/video models
4. Analyzes videos and audio thoroughly
5. Executes end-to-end with 40+ tools
6. Learns from every run and gets better on its own

news.title: Virality Predictor
news.body: Higgsfield shipped Virality Predictor — an experimental scorer that rates a clip's hook score, hold rate, and viral score plus a brain-activation heatmap (appears to be powered by Meta's TRIBE v2). Upload clips up to 15s. Available on the platform, via MCP, and CLI. Free during experimental preview.

news.title: Ad Reference
news.body: Higgsfield released Ad Reference — feed it your top-performing videos and it recreates the format on the platform or via MCP, with support for Claude, Hermes, and OpenClaw.

news.title: Higgsfield Hooks
news.body: Higgsfield rolled out Hooks — a way to wire generation events into custom workflows so creative pipelines react to renders the moment they finish.

news.title: Higgsfield CLI + Marketing Skills
news.body: Higgsfield launched a CLI and Marketing Skills pack designed to keep agent spend lean while shipping high-quality creative at scale. Pairs with Codex, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and others. Install via npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills.

news.title: NVIDIA Partnership for 30% Faster Training
news.body: Higgsfield announced an NVIDIA partnership — using NVIDIA HGX B200 and B300 systems for 30% faster training on its video models.

news.title: Higgsfield Canvas Is Live
news.body: A node-based workspace for team brainstorming and repeatable content pipelines. Plan pre-production and chat directly inside the canvas. Use an agent-built workflow or craft your own.

news.title: Higgsfield MCP Is Here
news.body: Higgsfield MCP is live — create content end-to-end inside any agent (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, NemoClaw). The only way to get agentic access to Seedance 2.0, GPT Images 2.0, and every other top model. Let your agents build content while you sleep.

news.title: Kling 3.0 Native 4K on Higgsfield
news.body: Kling 3.0 is now available in 4K on Higgsfield — native output from the model, not upscaled in post. Generate ads, film, and broadcast-ready footage directly from your prompt.

news.title: Marketing Studio
news.body: Meet Higgsfield Marketing Studio, powered by Hermes Agent. Create viral UGC ads for your website or app in a few clicks and distribute at unmatched speed.

news.title: GPT Image 2 on Higgsfield
news.body: GPT Image 2.0 lands on Higgsfield. OpenAI delivers perfect text rendering and ChatGPT-level reasoning in its SOTA image model.

news.title: Seedance 2.0 1080p on Higgsfield
news.body: Full HD Seedance 2.0 is rolling out to all Higgsfield features. World's best model — gotten even better.

news.title: Marketing Studio with Seedance 2.0
news.body: Introducing Higgsfield Marketing Studio powered by Seedance 2.0 - a single workflow from product to finished ad. Bring a product image or paste a URL, use an avatar or build one inside the tool, and generate your ad end-to-end in 9 styles: UGC, Hyper Motion, Tutorial, Unboxing, Product Review, TV Spot, Virtual Try On, and more.

title: Higgsfield Supercomputer

news.title: Sketch → Final Image: Style Transfer Workflow
news.body:
How to take lettering from sketch to final image in Figma Weave:
→ Import your sketch into Figma
→ Draw over it to create the vector letters
→ Export as a B&W PNG and import into Weave
→ Load style references in an 'image iterator' node
→ Add prompt: "Apply the style from Image 1 to the letters in Image 2"
→ Connect to image models (GPT Image 2, Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro)
→ Click "Run Model" and pick the winners

GPT Image 2 usually wins for style transfer, but YMMV.

news.title: New: Decisions API
news.body: The Decisions API answers questions about text, JSON, or images with probabilities instead of generated text. Use POST /v1/decisions with pplx-decider-v1-27b for yes-or-no, choice, or scored answers that application code can act on directly. Input costs \$0.04 per million tokens. Output tokens are free, with no per-request fee. See the Decisions API quickstart.

news.title: Native document input
news.body: The Agent API now accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, and RTF documents as input_file content. Send a document inline with file_data or provide a public HTTPS file_url. For inline documents, continue the conversation with previous_response_id without uploading the file again. See Working with Files.

news.title: Image Search
news.body: The new image_search tool searches for images on the web and returns typed image_search_results with image and source-page URLs. Use result limits plus domain, format, and safe-search filters to control the results. Usage reports successful calls at \$2.50 per 1,000 invocations; failed calls have zero tool cost. See Agent API Image Search.

news.title: Accurate sandbox extraction usage and costs
news.body: Agent API responses now include model token usage and cost for successful pplx_sdk.llm.extract calls made inside the sandbox tool. Per-model tokens appear in usage.tool_calls_details.sandbox.token_usage. The reported extraction cost appears in usage.tool_calls_details.sandbox.cost_usd and usage.cost.tool_calls_cost_details.sandbox, and contributes to usage.cost.total_cost. Sandbox extraction uses the existing openai/gpt-6-luna pricing, including cache creation, cache read, and reasoning-token dimensions. This corrects response-level usage and cost reporting; it does not change pricing or backfill historical responses.

news.title: Low, medium, and high presets use Fast Search

The xhigh preset is unchanged and continues to use standard web search. Models, prompts, tool budgets, and step limits are unchanged. To keep standard web search under any preset, set search_type: "web" on the web_search tool. See Agent API Web Search.

news.title: Inline citations for research presets
news.body: The Agent API's search-backed presets include inline citations: fast cites claims drawn from search results with numbered citations such as [1], while low, medium, and high now cite claims drawn from tool results or provided source artifacts with source-typed citations such as [web:1]. After a successful tool call, the low, medium, and high presets include at least one citation in the final answer. The current preset values include the system prompts for frozen configurations.

news.title: MCP Server 1.0: now backed by the Agent API
news.body: The Perplexity MCP Server v1.0.0 moves its model-backed tools from the legacy Sonar models to Agent API presets: perplexity_ask uses the fast preset, perplexity_reason uses medium, and perplexity_research uses high. Tool names and response shapes are unchanged, and all three tools are faster and cheaper on average than their Sonar predecessors. Long-running research now streams progress to MCP clients that request it, and cancelling an MCP request cancels the underlying run. The strip_thinking and reasoning_effort parameters were removed from the tool schemas (the Agent API emits no think tags, and presets manage reasoning effort); clients still sending them are ignored gracefully.

news.body: More models, tools, and research-backed presets: Sonar Chat Completions is now Agent API. Migration guide here.

news.title: Prompt caching for presets
news.body: Agent API presets now use stable prompt cache keys automatically, allowing independent requests with the same preset to reuse the shared prompt prefix (system prompt and tool definitions). No request changes are required, and an explicit prompt_cache_key still overrides the preset default. This can reduce costs by about 5% for applications that use presets frequently, depending on cache utilization. The current preset values include each key for frozen configurations.

news.title: Brain in Computer
news.body: Introducing Brain in Computer — a continuously learning memory system. Every task on Computer plugs into a context graph built by Brain, making Computer more stateful with every run. Available as a research preview for all Perplexity Max subscribers.

news.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra

news.title: Hybrid Agentic Inference

news.title: Search as Code
news.body: Introducing Search as Code — a new search architecture for AI agents that writes Python to call the search stack directly instead of looping through function calls.

news.title: Microsoft Office Integration
news.body: Perplexity Computer is now available inside Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook — orchestrate across work in the side panel.

news.title: Perplexity Computer Connects to Snowflake

news.title: Hosting Qwen3 235B on Blackwell
news.body: Perplexity published research on serving Qwen3 235B MoE models on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 racks — disaggregated prefill/decode, tensor parallelism, and NVLink throughput wins. GB200 is a major step up over Hopper for high-throughput inference on large MoE models.

title: Intercom
description: Customer messaging platform — live chat, helpdesk, product tours, and AI-powered support in one place.

news.title: Fill in the blanks when you use a macro
news.body: Macros can now include fill-in fields to personalize replies. Choosing one opens a short form for text, long-text, or choice values. Fields can be optional or required; optional sections can be switched on or off, and a live preview updates as teammates type. The completed reply appears in the composer for review and sending. Create these in Settings > Macros with Insert field, or from the inbox via Cmd+K > Create macro > Using a macro with fill-in fields. New Inbox.

news.title: Merge duplicate users into one profile
news.body: When the same customer ends up with two profiles, their conversations, tickets, and notes are split across both — and teammates lose the full picture. You can now merge one user into another: Merge a duplicate straight from the conversation sidebar, with a preview of everything that will move before you confirm Control who can merge with a new teammate permission Developers can merge users through the REST API (Preview) Learn more New feature Outbound Messaging

news.title: Choose bigger Tooltips that are easier to see and click
news.body: The default Tooltip icon is small — easy to miss, and difficult to tap for customers with low vision or limited hand movement. You can now set each Tooltip to Small, Medium, or Large. The size applies to icons, animated beacons, and labels. Medium and Large meet the WCAG 2.2 minimum target size of 24×24 pixels, so your Tooltips work for more of your customers. Existing Tooltips stay the same until you change them. Learn more here New feature Reporting

news.title: Build the metric you need, across your full history
news.body: Reports covers a lot of ground, but not every team's number is in the built-in set. A closure rate for email only, or a reopen rate on a single tag, wasn't something you could put on a chart. Now you can build it yourself — by applying your own filters to a built-in metric, or by dividing one metric by another with different filters on each side. Intercom calculates the metric when a chart loads, so anything you create today covers your full history. Custom metrics appear in the metric picker of every chart in your workspace. Open Reports, then Custom metrics, to build your first one. Learn more New feature Phone

news.title: See why an outbound call didn't connect
news.body: Until now, an outbound call that didn't connect showed a generic result, so teammates couldn't tell whether the number was wrong, the line was busy, or the call was blocked. Calls that don't connect now show a specific reason on the conversation: invalid number, line busy, declined by recipient, blocked by carrier, or region not permitted. If a call can't be placed at all, the teammate who dialled sees a message explaining why. Your team knows straight away whether to fix the number, or retry later. Learn more Inbox New

news.title: See who's viewing a conversation, now in Table view
news.body: Teammates' avatars now appear on conversation rows in the inbox Table view, so you can see at a glance when a colleague is already handling a conversation and avoid duplicate replies. New Inbox

news.title: Apply a macro when creating a ticket
news.body: Creating a ticket and applying a macro used to be two steps: create the ticket, reopen it, then apply the macro. Now you can do both at once. The ticket-creation screen now has the full composer — Reply and Note panes, with macro support. Pick a saved macro (or type its shortcut) and its message drops into the ticket, with follow-up actions like assigning or closing staged and ready. Hit Create ticket and the message becomes the first reply or note while the actions run automatically. Learn more Messenger Inbox

news.title: Read and copy code snippets more easily in conversations
news.body: Reading code in conversations just got easier. Code now renders in its own scrollable block, complete with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and a one-click copy button. You can also enter a full-screen view to easily read longer snippets. Learn More New feature Data Connectors

news.title: Connect Fin to your tools without building a connector from scratch
news.body: Until now, connecting Fin to your tools meant building a data connector yourself: configuring the technical details by hand. Data connector templates are now generally available, with ready-to-install templates across Stripe, Shopify and Statuspage. Install a template from the data connector catalog in your workspace, customize it and make it available to Fin directly or add it to a Procedure. New feature Data Connectors

news.title: Track data connector health over time
news.body: Until now, the Data Connector health page showed HTTP status codes as a single snapshot — so you couldn't tell when a connector started failing or whether a fix held. Now status codes appear as a chart over time, right alongside the existing latency chart, on whatever time range you've already selected. See exactly when errors started, which status codes came back, and confirm a fix actually worked. Find it under Settings > Integrations > Data connectors, on any connector's Health tab. Learn more Inbox New

news.title: Export a saved View exactly as you see it
news.body: Getting the current contents of a View out of Intercom meant rebuilding its filters in a report or copying rows by hand — and a report answers a different question anyway: what happened over a date range, not what matches right now. Teammates can now export any saved Inbox View to CSV as a point-in-time snapshot, with the same columns, the same sort order, and a link back to every conversation. Slice it in a spreadsheet, share it with your team, or use the conversation links to act on it directly in Intercom. Exports up to 25,000 cells download immediately; larger ones arrive by email. Open a saved View in the Inbox and select Export as CSV. Learn more New feature Reporting

news.title: See how long tickets spend with every team that touches them
news.body: Until now, a ticket's time counted only against the team currently assigned — so once it handed off, the earlier team's time disappeared from your reports and the path it took couldn't be reported on at all. You can now report on every assignment a ticket passes through. A new Ticket assignments dataset measures how long a ticket sits with each team and teammate, counts handoffs, and shows which team pairs pass work back and forth. A new Sankey chart draws the full path your tickets take. A prebuilt Tickets lifecycle report puts all of it on one page. Find it in Reports, under the Tickets lifecycle template. Learn more New feature Data Connectors

media.alt: The Tickets lifecycle report open in Intercom, showing the Ticket handoff Sankey chart across the full width at the top — with columns for each handoff hop and

news.title: Fin can now query your Snowflake data warehouse
news.body: The data Fin needs most to resolve conversations, like orders, subscriptions, usage, and billing, often lives in Snowflake, and until now Fin couldn't reach it. With the Snowflake MCP Connector, Fin securely connects directly to an MCP server running inside your own Snowflake account. Connect Snowflake from Settings > Data connectors, then choose which tools Fin can use. The connection runs under a Snowflake role you pick, so your existing permissions, masking, and row-level access policies apply automatically, and nothing is copied or synced out of Snowflake. Learn more New Outbound Messaging

news.title: Catch customer incidents before they escalate
news.body: Real Time Incident Detection surfaces emerging customer problems as they happen, so your team can respond before they escalate. Respond before incidents escalate: Get alerted in Slack or email the moment an incident starts forming, so you can act before it affects more customers. Understand the impact instantly: See what customers are experiencing, how severe the incident is, and how many conversations are affected, with full visibility into every related conversation. Resolve incidents faster: Use Operator to contact affected customers in bulk, close conversations, or update Fin with guidance so it can handle new conversations consistently while the incident is active. Learn more New Fin

news.title: Fin now remembers past conversations
news.body: Fin now remembers. Returning customers pick up where they left off, carry their context across channels, so they don't have to repeat what they've already told you. No more starting over: Fin remembers what's already been covered, so returning customers continue from the next step instead of the beginning. Faster resolution, less effort. Context follows the channel: The same memory travels with the customer from chat to email, so the experience stays joined up no matter how they get in touch. Responses that feel personal: Fin draws on what a customer has shared before, so answers feel like they come from a company that actually knows them. Learn more ‹ Prev 1 of 75 Next › Your Privacy Choices

news.title: Set more complex Series live, reliably
news.body: Complex Series — those with many steps, rules, and email messages — could sometimes fail to go live with an error, even when the Series was correctly configured. Now activation runs in the background, so complex Series go live reliably. You'll see progress as it activates and a confirmation once it's live. Customers start entering as soon as they match your entry rules. Learn more here New Apps & API

news.title: Keep your integrations in sync with translated replies
news.body: Until now, when Intercom translated a teammate's reply, your integration had no way to know — it had to poll the API to catch up. Two new webhook topics now fire as soon as a translation is saved, delivering the translated text for every language alongside the original: conversation.admin.replied.translated ticket.admin.replied.translated To use them, subscribe under Settings → Integrations → Webhooks and set your app to the Preview API version. One thing to note: replies sent from the Inbox always trigger these topics. Replies created through the REST API only trigger them when the full body is wrapped in HTML block elements. View API Documentation ​ Inbox New

news.title: Configurable Unsnooze Controls
news.body: Internal notes and assignment changes no longer have to wake a snoozed conversation. Turn on two new settings to keep it snoozed until a customer replies, the timer ends, or you reopen it yourself. We've also moved the existing back-office ticket setting to sit alongside them, so all your unsnooze controls now live in one place. New Security & Settings

news.title: Export teammate and activity log data to your own storage, on schedule
news.body: Until now, scheduled data exports covered conversations only — so anyone reviewing workspace access or auditing changes had to pull that data by hand. You can now choose which data objects each scheduled export includes: Teammates — every teammate in your workspace, with their name, email address, and role. Teammate activity logs — a record of account activity such as logins, permission changes, and SSO changes. Both are delivered to your cloud storage on the same schedule as your conversations, so your access and audit trail is already waiting when a compliance review comes around. Learn more New Phone Reporting

news.title: Your whole phone operation on one screen
news.body: Phone was the one channel you couldn't watch as a whole. You could open an individual call, but nothing showed you the state of the operation — so staffing and service-level problems only surfaced after customers had already waited. The new Phone tab on the Inbox Dashboard puts it all in one place: callers waiting and for how long, which agents are available, on a call, or in wrap-up, who is listening in for coaching, live SLA compliance, and a per-team breakdown — all updating in real time. Switch to Today for the day's call feed, outcomes, and speed-of-answer and abandonment histograms, or Weekly for seven-day trends, hourly heatmaps, and week-over-week comparisons. Learn more Fin Data Connectors

news.title: Connect Fin for Sales directly to your HubSpot account
news.body: You can now connect Fin for Sales directly to your HubSpot account and build a working data connector in minutes. ​ Authenticate with HubSpot, and our AI generator inspects your instance to build a fully configured connector. Review the suggested mappings, make any changes, and add it to your setup. ​ Fin can then pull live contact context into every sales conversation and sync qualified contacts back to HubSpot. ​ Learn more New Phone

news.title: Your hold music now plays on mid-call holds
news.body: Until now, your hold audio only played to callers waiting in a queue. When a teammate put a caller on hold mid-call, they heard generic stock music instead. Now mid-call holds play your own audio: the same track callers hear in the queue by default, or a separate one you upload just for mid-call holds — so you can play an apology or an on-hold message instead of queue music. Find it in Settings > Phone Calls, under In-call hold music. Learn more New Inbox

news.title: Control which conversations teammates can take or drop
news.body: Fair workload distribution breaks down when teammates can pick their own conversations or drop the ones they don't want. Two new Inbox permissions let you close that gap, configured per teammate: Can assign conversations to themselves: prevents teammates from grabbing work outside your routing rules Can remove themselves as the assignee: prevents teammates from dropping conversations they've been assigned Automated routing, workflows, and round-robin or load-balanced assignment are unaffected. Learn more New Pro

news.body: Breaking changes This release has major breaking changes to Bases. We have updated the Bases formula syntax and the file format to make formulas and filters more expressive and powerful. If you use Obsidian on multiple devices, we recommend upgrading all devices at the same time to avoid issues syncing base files with different syntax. The new formula syntax The new formula syntax is more flexible, easier to use, and better suited to extensibility. For those familiar with Javascript, the new syntax should feel familiar. New functions and types are described in our docs. Some highlights include: Functions are now object-oriented. Functions can now be chained. e.g. property.split(' ').sort()[0].lower() Property names are no longer wrapped in backticks (`). Instead, to reference properties with spaces or special characters, the syntax is note["Property Name"] There is a new type system which provides greater control when writing formulas. news.title: Obsidian 2025.08.22 (Public)
news.body: Obsidian Sync has received a minor security upgrade. File names have always been end-to-end encrypted, but they're now protected using an even stronger method. All new vaults automatically use this stronger encryption. Existing vaults can be upgraded with the new migration assistant in Obsidian 1.9.11. The old method of encrypting file paths and hashes derived the initialization vector (IV) from a hash of the string. In rare cases, this could create a pattern that an attacker might try to take advantage of if they were able to get access to your encrypted data. Now, file paths and hashes are encrypted with AES-SIV so those patterns can no longer exist. The way file contents are encrypted hasn't changed, they've always been secured with AES-GCM.

news.title: Introducing ChatGPT Space
news.body: OpenAI introduced Space, a shared home for pages and files where teammates can work together with ChatGPT, Codex, and dots. People can edit pages in real time, comment, and ask AI to organize or update shared work. Space is available on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans on web and desktop. On mobile, people can find, read, and share pages; creating and editing pages are coming later.
